sign list.notes:
Ideo. in 𓊃𓀀𓏤 [t]s (si)[/t] 'man'. Ideo. or det. 'I', 'me' in 𓀀 [t]i[/t], 𓅱𓀀 [t]wi[/t], 𓏌𓎡 [t]ink[/t], 𓎡𓅱𓀀 [t]=kwi[/t]. Det. man's relationships or occupations, exx. 𓅭𓏤𓀀 [t]sꜢ[/t] 'son'; 𓋴𓍋𓂋 [t]smr[/t] 'courtier'; 𓎛𓅨𓂋𓅱𓅨_𓀀 [t]ḥwrw[/t] 'wretch'; 𓁹𓂋𓂋 [t]irr[/t] 'doer'; also personal names, ex. 𓋹𓈖𓐍𓅱𓀀 [t]ꜥnḫw[/t] '[t]ꜥAnkhu[/t]'. In personal names, 𓀀𓏥 is abbrev. for 𓂋𓎛𓅱𓀀𓏥 [t]rḥw[/t] 'men', ex. 𓀀𓏥𓋹𓈖𓐍 [t]Rḥw-ꜥnḫ[/t] '[t]Reḥuꜥonkh[/t]'.
Seated man and woman with plural strokes: Det. people and their occupations, exx. 𓂋𓍿𓀀𓁐𓏥 [t]rmṯ[/t] 'people'; 𓌙𓅓𓅱𓀀𓁐𓏥 [t]ꜥꜢmw[/t] 'Asiatics'; 𓂸𓏏𓂋𓅱𓂭𓂭𓀀𓁐𓏥 [t]mtrw[/t] 'witnesses'.

Det. eat, exx. 𓃹𓈖𓅓𓀁 [t]wnm[/t] 'eat'; 𓎛𓈎𓂋𓀁 [t]ḥqr[/t] 'hungry'; drink, ex. 𓋴𓅨𓂋𓇋𓈗𓀁 [t]sw(r)i[/t] 'drink'; speak, exx. 𓋴𓆓𓂧𓀁 [t]sḏd[/t] 'relate'; 𓎼𓂋𓀁 [t]gr[/t] 'be silent'; think, ex. 𓎡𓄿𓀁 [t]kꜢi[/t] 'devise'; feel, ex. 𓌻𓂋𓀁 [t]mri[/t] 'love'.
Det. in 𓈞𓊃𓀂 [t]ḥmsi[/t] 'sit'. Replaced in hieratic by 𓀔 A 17 or 𓀕 A 17* or even by 𓁓 B 4.
Det. supplicate, ex. 𓇼𓄿𓀃 [t]dwꜢ[/t] 'adore'; hide, exx. 𓋴𓂧𓎼𓄿𓀃𓂻 [t]sdgꜢ[/t] 'be hidden'; 𓇋𓏠𓈖𓀃 [t]imn[/t] 'hide'.
Det. hide, ex. 𓇋𓏠𓈖𓀄𓏛 [t]imn[/t] 'hide'.

sign list.description: man receiving purification (in M.E. usually replaced by 𓃂 D 60)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in 𓀆 var. Pyr. 𓅱𓂝𓃂 [t]wꜥb[/t] 'pure', 'clean'.

sign list.description: man sinking to ground from fatigue
sign list.notes: Det. weary, weak, exx. 𓅨𓂋_𓂧_𓀉 [t]wrd[/t] 'tire'; 𓃀𓂧𓈙𓀉 [t]bdš[/t] 'faint'; 𓎼_𓈖𓈖𓀉 [t]gnn[/t] 'be soft'.
Det. in 𓉔𓈖_𓏌𓅱𓀊 [t]hnw[/t] 'jubilation'.

sign list.description: man steadying basket (𓎺 W 10) on his head
sign list.notes: Det. in 𓄿𓍿𓊪𓀋 abbrev. 𓀋𓂝 [t]Ꜣṯp[/t] 'load'; 𓆑𓄿𓀋 abbrev. 𓀋𓂝 [t]fꜢi[/t] 'carry'; 𓂓𓏏𓀋 abbrev. 𓀋 [t]kꜢt[/t] 'work'.
Det. in 𓋴𓐪𓂧𓏌𓀌 [t]sqdw[/t] 'sail'.

sign list.description: man holding the aba scepter 𓌂 S 42 and crook 𓋿 S 39 (O.K.)
sign list.notes: O.K. ideo. or det in 𓀍 var. 𓐍𓈖𓅓𓋴𓀍 [t]ḫnms[/t] 'friend'. Later replaced by 𓀙 A 21.
Ideo. or det. in 𓀎𓏪 var. 𓅓_𓈙𓂝𓀎 [t]mšꜥ[/t] 'army'. Det. in 𓏠𓈖𓆑_𓇋𓇋_𓏏𓀎𓏪 [t]mnfyt[/t] 'soldiers'

sign list.description: man with arms tied behind his back
sign list.notes: Det. enemy, exx. 𓋴𓃀𓇋𓌙𓀏 [t]sbi[/t] 'rebel'; 𓐍𓏏𓆑𓀏 [t]ḫfty[/t] 'enemy'.

sign list.description: man with blood streaming from his head.
sign list.notes: Det. die, ex. 𓅓𓏏𓀐 [t]mwt[/t] 'die'; enemy, ex. 𓐍𓏏𓆑𓀐 [t]ḫfty[/t] 'enemy'.

sign list.description: as A 14 but blood interpreted as an axe
sign list.notes: Use as A 14.
Ideo. or det. in 𓐍𓂋_𓀒 var. 𓀒 [t]ḫr[/t] ‘fall’ and derivatives. Abbrev. 𓀒𓅱 for 𓐍𓂋𓅱𓀒 [t]ḫrw[/t] ‘fallen (i.e. conquered) enemy’; also 𓀒𓏏 for 𓋴_𓐍𓂋𓏏𓀒 [t]sḫrt[/t] ‘overthrow’ (infinitive).
Det. in 𓎡_𓋴_𓀓 [t]ksi[/t] ‘bow down’.

sign list.description: child sitting (on lap) with hand to mouth
sign list.notes: Det. young, exx. 𓂋𓈖𓊪𓆳𓀔 [t]rnpi[/t] ‘be young’; 𓈙𓂋𓇋𓀔 [t]šri[/t] ‘child’; 𓈖𓌰𓅓𓎛𓀔𓅪 [t]nmḥ[/t] ‘orphan’. Abbrev. 𓀔_𓀀, 𓀔 for 𓄡𓂋𓂧𓀔 [t]ẖrd[/t] ‘child’. Phon. nni in 𓇓_𓏏𓈖𓀔𓈖𓈖𓊖 [t]Nni[/t]-nsw ‘Heracleopolis’.

sign list.description: child in sitting posture, arms hanging down
sign list.notes: Adapted from hieratic, where it replaces 𓀂 A 3, ex. 𓈞𓊃𓀔 [t]ḥmsi[/t] ‘sit’, or 𓀔 A 17, ex. 𓄟𓅱𓀔𓏥 [t]msw[/t] ‘children’.

sign list.description: child with crown of Lower Egypt 𓋔 S 3
sign list.notes: Det. child-king, exx. 𓇋𓈖𓊪𓀖 [t]inp[/t] 'crown prince', 'royal child'; 𓎘𓎛𓀖 [t]wḏḥ[/t] 'weaned princeling'.

sign list.description: bent man leaning on stick (clearly distinquishable from 𓀙 A 21 in hieratic, not always so in hieroglyphic).
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. old, in 𓇋𓄿𓅱𓀗 var. 𓀗 [t]iꜢw[/t] 'old'; 𓋴𓅓𓋴𓅱𓀗 var. 𓀗 [t]smsw (śmśw)[/t] 'eldest'; great in 𓅨𓂋𓀗 var. 𓀗 [t]wr[/t] 'great one', 'chief'. Det. old, also in 𓏏𓈖𓇋𓀗 [t]tni[/t] 'old'; lean, exx. 𓂋𓉔𓈖𓀗 [t]rhn[/t] 'lean; 𓏏𓍯𓄿𓀗 [t]twꜢ[/t] 'support oneself'. Phon. or phon. det. ik (from a rare [t]iꜢk[/t] be aged) in 𓇋𓎡𓀗 var. 𓀗𓇋𓇋 [t]iky[/t] 'miner', 'hewer of stone'. In M.K. hieratic 𓎛𓀗𓀜 is written for [t]ḥwi[/t], [t]ḥii[/t] 'strike'.

sign list.description: man leaning on forked stick, less senile than 𓀗 A 19
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in 𓀘 much rarer var. 𓋴𓅓𓋴𓅱𓀘 [t]smsw (śmśw)[/t] 'eldest', especially in 𓅭𓏤𓆑𓀘 [t]sꜢ[/t]=f smsw 'his eldest son', cf. Pyr. 𓅭𓊃𓎡𓋴𓅓𓇓𓅱𓏯 [t]zꜢ[/t]=k śmśw, and in the title 𓀘𓇯 var. 𓋴𓅓𓋴𓅱𓉔𓇋𓇋𓏏𓇯𓀀 [t]smsw[/t] hyt 'elder of the portal'

sign list.description: man holding stick in one hand and handkerchief in the other (always distinct from 𓀗 A 19 in hieratic)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in 𓋴𓂋𓀙 var. 𓀙 [t]sr (śr)[/t] 'official', 'noble'. Det. magnate, exx. 𓍲𓈖𓇋𓇋𓏏𓀙𓀀𓏥 [t]šnyt[/t] 'courtiers'; 𓋴𓍋𓅓𓂋𓀙 [t]smr[/t] 'courtier', 'friend' (of the king). Also det. in 𓐍𓈖𓌰𓅓𓋴𓀙 [t]ḫnms[/t] 'friend', here replacing an older sign 𓀍 A 11; in 𓂙𓈖𓍘𓀙 [t]ẖnti[/t] 'statue' replacing 𓀚 A 22. In hieroglyphic 𓀙 is often hard to distinguish from 𓀗 A 19 (in the word wr 'chief') and from 𓀘 A 20.

sign list.description: statue of a man with stick in ꜥbꜣ-sceptre 𓌂 S 42
sign list.notes: Det. in 𓂙𓈖𓏏𓀚 [t]ẖnt(y)[/t] 'statue' and in 𓏏𓅱𓏏𓀚 [t]twt[/t] 'statue'. The form of the sign varies according to the nature of the statue to be depicted.

sign list.description: king with stick and club 𓌉 T 3
sign list.notes: Det. in 𓇋𓍘𓇋𓇋𓀛 [t]ity[/t] 'sovereign'.

Det. in 𓎛𓀜 [t]ḥwi[/t], [t]ḥii[/t] ‘strike’. Hence det. force, effort, exx. 𓈖𓆱𓐍𓏏𓀜 abbrev. 𓀜 [t]nḫt[/t] ‘strong’; [t]nḥm[/t] ‘take away’; 𓎛𓂝​𓍑𓄿𓀜 [t]ḥꜥḏꜢ[/t] ‘plunder’; 𓋴𓃀𓇼𓄿𓀜 [t]sbꜢ[/t] ‘teach’. In Dyn XVIII hieroglyphic 𓀜 is mostly replaced by 𓂡 [t]D[/t] 40, which either as 𓂡 [t]or[/t] 𓂝 is also common in hieratic.

sign list.description: man striking, with left arm hanging behind back
sign list.notes: Rare ideo. used in 𓀝 [t]ḥwi[/t], [t]ḥii[/t] 'strike'. In papyri of Dyn. XII 'strike' is written 𓎛𓀗𓀜 [t]with[/t] a sign identical to 𓀗 A 19.

sign list.description: man with one arm raised in invocation
sign list.notes: Det. call, exx. 𓈖𓇋𓋴𓀞 [t]nis[/t] 'call', 'summon'; 𓈋𓇋𓀞 [t]ḏwi[/t] 'call'. Abbrev. [t]ꜥš[/t] in 𓄔𓀞 [t]sḏm-ꜥš[/t] 'servant', lit. 'one who hears the call'. Det. in the vocative interjection 𓇋𓀞 [t]i[/t] 'O'.

sign list.description: man hastening with one arm raised
sign list.notes: Cf. Pyr. 𓇋𓏎𓂻𓂻𓂻 [t]inw[/t] 'messengers'. Hence phon. in in 𓇋𓀟𓈖 [t]in[/t] 'by'.

Det. high, in 𓈎𓄿𓀠 [t]vꜥrr[/t]. 𓈎𓀠𓏛, 𓀠 [t]ḳꜢ[/t](i)[/t] 'be high'. Det. joy, exx. 𓎛𓂝𓀠 [t]ḥꜥi[/t] 'rejoice'; 𓋴𓍯𓈙𓀠 [t]swꜢš[/t] 'extol'; mourn, in 𓎛𓄿𓀠 [t]ḥꜢi[/t] 'mourn'; also, for unknown reasons, in 𓇋𓄿𓋴𓀠 [t]iꜢs[/t] 'bald'.
Det. in 𓋴𓐍𓂧𓀡 [t]sḫd[/t] 'be upside down'.

sign list.description: man with arms outstreched (cf. 𓀃 A 4)
sign list.notes: Det. praise, exx. 𓇋𓄿𓅱𓀢 [t]iꜢw[/t] 'praise'; 𓇼𓀢 [t]dwꜢ[/t] 'adore'; 𓋴𓍯𓈙𓀢 [t]swꜢš[/t] 'extol'; supplicate, ex. 𓏏𓍯𓄿𓀢 [t]twꜢ[/t] 'claim'; awe, in 𓏏𓂋𓆵𓀢𓏛 [t]tr[/t] 'show respect for'.

sign list.description: man with arms stretched out behind him
sign list.notes: Det. turn away, ex. 𓂝𓈖𓏌𓅱𓀣 [t]ꜥnw[/t] 'averted' (face).
Det. dance, ex 𓐍𓃀𓀤 [t]ḫbi[/t] 'dance'; joy, ex. 𓉔𓇋𓇋𓉔𓈖𓏌𓅱𓀤 [t]hy-hnw[/t] 'jubilate'.

sign list.description: man with stick and bundle or mat on shoulder
sign list.notes: Ideo. in 𓀦 var. 𓏠𓈖𓇋𓅱𓀦 [t]m(i)[/t]niw 'herdsman'. Det. wanderer, exx. 𓂋𓅱𓀦 [t]rwi[/t] 'wander'; 𓈙𓌳𓄿𓅓𓅱𓀦𓀀𓏥 [t]šm(Ꜣ)w[/t] 'wanderers', 'strangers'.
Det. in 𓐍𓅱𓋴𓀧 [t]ḫwsi[/t] 'pound', 'build'.
Ideo. or det. in 𓐪𓂧𓏌𓀨 var. 𓀨 [t]qd[/t] 'build'.

sign list.description: man kneading and straining into a vessel
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in 𓀩𓏏𓏭𓀜 var. 𓂝𓆑𓏏𓀩, 𓀪𓏏𓏭 [t]ꜥfty[/t] 'brewer'.
Use as last.

sign list.description: man holding necks of two emblematic animals with panther heads (Dyn. XII)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in 𓀫 [t]varr[/t]. 𓀬, 𓈎𓇋𓋴𓊖 [t]Qis[/t], var. Dyn. XVIII 𓀫𓋴𓏭𓊖 [t]Qsy[/t] 'Cusae', the modern town of El-Kusiyah in Upper Egypt.
Use as last.

sign list.description: seated god (Note the slightly curved beard and straight wig)
sign list.notes: Det. god (replacing earlier 𓅆 [t]G[/t] 7), exx. 𓊪𓏏𓎛𓀭 [t]Ptḥ[/t] 'Ptah'; 𓏠𓈖𓍿𓅱𓀭 [t]Mnṯw[/t] '(the god) Mont'. Ideo. or det. 'I', 'me', in 𓀭 =i, 𓅱𓀭 =wi, 𓏌𓎡𓀭 [t]ink[/t] when a god is speaking or, in Dyn. XII, the king.

sign list.description: king.  (Note uraeus on brow, straight beard, and coif)
sign list.notes: Det. king (common Dyn. XVIII), exx. 𓇓𓏏𓈖 [t]nsw[/t] 'king'; 𓍛𓏤𓀯 [t]ḥm[/t] 'majesty; 𓎟𓀯 [t]nb[/t] 'the Lord' . Ideo. or det. 'I', 'me' in 𓀯 =i, 𓅱𓀯 =wi, 𓏌𓎡𓀯 =ink when the king is speaking.

sign list.description: the same but with flagellum 𓌅 S 45.
sign list.notes: Use as last (common Dyn XVIII).

sign list.description: king wearing crown of Upper Egypt 𓋑 S 1
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in 𓇓𓏏𓈖𓀲 [t]nsw (nzw, ni-śwt)[/t] 'king of Upper Egypt', 'king'. Det. 𓊨𓁹𓀲 [t]Wsir[/t] 'Osiris'.

sign list.description: the same, but with flagellum 𓌅 S 45
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.description: king wearing crown of Lower Egypt
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in 𓆤𓏏𓀵 var. 𓀵 [t]bity[/t] 'king of Lower Egypt'.

sign list.description: the same, but with flagellum 𓌅 S 45
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.description: shepherd seated and wrapped in mantle, holding a stick with appendage.
sign list.notes: Ideo. in 𓀸𓅱 var. Pyr. 𓏠𓈖𓇋𓅱𓀜 [t]m(i)[/t]niw 'herdsman'. Ideo. or det. in 𓊃𓅭𓄿𓀸𓀜 [t]sꜢw[/t] 'guard', 'protect'. Sometimes inaccurately for 𓀹 A 48 in 𓇋𓂋𓀸 [t]iry[/t] 'relating to'.
Ideo.(?) or det. iry in 𓇋𓂋𓀸 var. 𓀸'relating to', 'belonging to'.
Det. foreigner, exx. 𓌙𓅓𓅱𓀺𓏪 [t]ꜥꜢmw[/t] 'Asiatics'; 𓉺𓉺𓉺𓐮𓄿𓀺𓀺𓀺 [t]Iwntyw-štyw[/t] 'Nubian bowmen'.

sign list.description: man of rank seated on chair
sign list.notes: Det. revered persons (M.K.; in Dyn. XVIII mainly replaced by 𓀼 A 51 and 𓀽 A 52), exx. 𓋴𓈖𓃀𓅱𓀻 [t]snbw[/t] 'Sonbu', or personal name; 𓋴𓍋𓅓𓂋𓀻𓏪 [t]smr(w)[/t] 'courtiers'. Ideo. or det. 'I', 'me' on M.K. coffins in 𓀻 =i, 𓅱𓀻 =wi, 𓏌𓎡𓀻 =ink. Rarely ideo. like 𓀼 A 51 in 𓀻 [t]šps[/t] (špś)[/t] 'noble'.
Ideo. in [t]špsi[/t] (špśi)'be noble' and related words. After M.K., often det. revered persons. ex. [t]imyw-ḥꜢt[/t] 'those of former times'.

sign list.description: noble squatting with flagellum S 45 (common in Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Det. revered persons, especially personal names, ex. [t]PꜢ-ḥry[/t] 'Paheri', a man's name; [t]sꜥḥ[/t] 'deceased noble'. Rarely also for A 51 in [t]šps[/t] 'noble'.
Det. mummy, ex. wi 'mummy'; statue, likeness, ex. twt 'statue'; form, shape, exx. ki 'form'; [t]ḫprw[/t] 'forms', 'stages of growth'.
Det, dead, exx. m(i)ni 'death'; [t]nb-ꜥnḫ[/t] 'sarcophagus', lit. 'lord-of-life'.

sign list.description: mummy lying on bed (replacing O.K. form with man on bed).
sign list.notes: Det., lie, ex. [t]sḏr[/t] 'lie', 'spend all night'; death, exx. [t]ḫpt[/t] 'deceased'; [t]ẖꜢt[/t] 'corpse'.
Det. 'drive away' in 𓋴𓁷𓂋𓁄 [t]sḥr[/t] 'drive away'.

Det. female, exx. st ‘woman’; [t]ḥmt[/t] ‘woman’, ‘wife’; ntrt ‘goddess’; woman’s relationships, exx. [t]sꜢt[/t] ‘daughter’; [t]ẖꜢrt[/t] ‘widow’; her occupations, exx. [t]ḥmt[/t] ‘female slave’; [t]šmꜥyt[/t] ‘chantress’; her name, ex. Nfrt ‘Nofret’. As suffix 1st pers. sing. ‘I’, ‘my’ (fem.) i has not been noted before Dyn XIX.
Det. pregnant, exx. iwr ‘conceive’; [t]bkꜢ[/t] ‘be pregnant’.
Ideo. or det. in msi (mśi) ‘bear’, ‘give birth’ and the related words.

sign list.description: combination of sign for a squatting woman (cf. B 3) with F 31.
sign list.notes: Use as last. In one hieratic MS. substituted for A 3.
Det. ‘suckle’ in [t]mnꜥt[/t] ‘nurse’, ‘foster-mother’.

sign list.description: woman seated on chair with child on lap
sign list.notes: Det. ‘nurse’ in rnn ‘nurse’, ‘rear’.

sign list.description: queen wearing diadem and carrying flower
sign list.notes: Det. of names of queens.

sign list.description: god with sun and uraeus on head
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]Rꜥ[/t] (the sun god) Ra.

sign list.description: god with head of falcon bearing sun on head G 9 and holding ankh S 34
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]Rꜥ[/t] '(the sun god) Ra'.
Ideo. or det. in Ḏhwty 'Thoth'.

sign list.description: god with head of ram E 10
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in H̱nmw 'Khnum'.
Use as last.

sign list.description: god with head of dog E 15
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ꜥI[/t]͗npw 'Anubis'; also in [t]Wp-wꜢwt[/t] 'Wepwawet'.

sign list.description: god with head of Seth animal E 20
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]Stẖ[/t] (Śtš) 'Seth'.

sign list.description: ithyphallic god with feathers, uplifted arm and flagellum S 45
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in Mnw 'Min'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]Ḥt-ḥr[/t] 'Hathor'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]MꜢꜥt[/t] 'Maat', the goddess of Truth.

sign list.description: god with arms supporting (the sky) and M 4 on head (often also without M 4)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in Ḥḥ ('one of the gods) Heh'. Hence pron. [t]ḥḥ[/t] in [t]ḥḥ[/t] 'millions', 'many'.
Ideo. or det. for Amun. (Dyn XIX and later).
Ideo. or det. for Montu (Dyn. XIX and later)
Ideo. or det. for Tjanen (Dyn XIX and later).
Ideo. or det. in [t]Ptaḥ[/t] (Dyn. XIX and later).
Ideo. or det. for [t]Ptaḥ[/t] (Dyn. XIX and later).

sign list.category_group: D, Parts of the human body
sign list.notes: Ideo. in tp 'head' and tpy 'chief', 'first'. Det. head, exx. [t]ḏꜢḏꜢ[/t] 'head'; [t]ḥꜢ[/t] 'back of head', whence prep. [t]ḥꜢ[/t] 'behind' and [t]mkḥꜢ[/t] 'neglect'; dhnt 'forehead', whence dhn 'promote', etc.; perhaps with notion throttle, in [t]gwꜢwꜢ[/t] 'fetter', 'bind fast'. Possible possessed the value [t]ḏꜢḏꜢ[/t] in some cases where there is no evidence to prove it. Of the two words for 'head' [t]ḏꜢḏꜢ[/t] alone has survived into Coptic.

sign list.category_group: D, Parts of the human body
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ḥr[/t] 'face' and derivatives. Hence the phon. [t]ḥr[/t], exx. [t]ḥr[/t] 'prepare'; [t]dḥr[/t] 'bitter', 'sour'.

sign list.category_group: D, Parts of the human body

XVIII, mainly replaced as det. by the more specific signs D 5, D 6, D 7 and D 9. From the end of Dyn. Ideo. in wpt 'brow', 'top (of forehead)', 'beginning'. Hence phon. wp, ex. var. Pyr. wpi 'divide', 'open'; in two words reads i, viz ipt 'mission'; ipwty 'messenger'.
In wpt-rnpt 'New Year's day'.

sign list.description: combination of the last and N 5
sign list.notes: Use as last.
Ideo. or det. in db 'horn'; [t]ḥnt[/t] horn'; det. [t]ꜥb[/t] 'horn'. From this last, phon. or phon. det. [t]ꜥb[/t], exx. [t]ꜥbꜥ[/t] 'boast'; [t]m-ꜥb[/t] 'together with'.

sign list.description: combination of F 16 with a vase with water, cf. D 60
sign list.notes: In [t]ꜥbw[/t] 'purification'.

Det. tooth, exx. [t]ibḥ[/t] 'tooth'; [t]nḥdt[/t] 'tooth'; also action connected therewith, exx. [t]psḥ[/t] 'bite'; sbt 'laugh'; (influenced by [t]sbḥ[/t] 'cry'?). From [t]ibḥ[/t], phon. or phon. det. [t]bḥ[/t], exx. [t]bḥs[/t] 'calf'; [t]sbḥ[/t] 'cry'. For unknown reason, phon. det. [t]ḥw[/t] in Ḥw 'Hw', the god of authoritative utterance; [t]ḥw[/t] 'sustenance'; hence in group-writing with book scroll is [t]ḥ[/t], ex. [t]Mḥ[/t] 'Mahu', a personal name. In words reading [t]biꜢ[/t], exx. [t]biꜢ[/t] 'firmament', [t]biꜢt[/t] 'wonder', is possibly not a tooth, but a metal spout. Phon. det. bi in bit 'character'.
Det. in [t]ꜥrt[/t] 'jaw'.

Ideo. in ns 'tongue'. Hence phon. ns (nś), exx. n(y)-sw 'he belonging to'; nsr 'flame'. Det. actions connected with tongue, ex. dp 'taste'. Sportive ideo. in imy-r 'overseer', lit. 'one who is in the mouth'. Sometimes confused with the abbreviated det. for death, enemy, Z 6.

Ideo. or det. ear, exx. [t]msḏr[/t] 'ear'; [t]ꜥnḫwy[/t] 'the two ears'; also in actions connected with ear, exx. [t]sḏm[/t], var. Pyr. śḏm, 'hear'; idi 'be deaf'. Phon. or phon. det. idn 'replace'; idnw 'deputy'. In medical papyri 'leaf (of a tree)' is to be read [t]ḏrḏ[/t], there too sdm (Pyr. śdm) 'paint' eyebrows), after śḏm 'hear' had become sdm.

Ideo. in [t]pḥwy[/t] 'hind-quarters', 'end'; hence phon. or phon. det. [t]pḥ[/t], exx. [t]pḥ[/t] 'reach'; [t]pḥty[/t] 'strength'. Det in [t]kfꜢ[/t] 'bottom' (of vase, etc.); hence phon. or phon. det. [t]kfꜢ[/t] in [t]kfꜢ-ib[/t] 'trusty'. Also det. in [t]ꜥrt[/t] 'hind-quarters'.

sign list.description: foreleg of ox (thus always in hieratic)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫpš[/t] 'foreleg', 'arm'. Det in [t]Msḫtyw[/t] 'the Great Bear', lit. 'the Foreleg'.
Use as last.
Ideo. in [t]wḥmt[/t] 'hoof' of ox. By transference to donkey, semi-ideo. in [t]wḥm[/t](t?) 'hoof', figuratively for 'asses'. Hence phon. [t]wḥm[/t] 'reapeat',
Ideo. in [t]ẖnt[/t] 'skin'. Hence phon. [t]ẖn[/t](w), exx. [t]ẖnw[/t] 'interior'; [t]ẖn[/t] 'approach'.
Det. skin, exx. [t]dḥr[/t] 'hide', 'leather'; [t]mskꜢ[/t] 'skin', 'rug'; mammals generally, exx. [t]wnš[/t] 'wolf'; pnw 'mouse'.

This form is regular as ideo. dappled in [t]sꜢb[/t] [t]šwt[/t] 'variegated of feathers', epithet of the solar Horus, cf. Pyr. śꜢb 'variegated'. Sometimes replaces [t]Ꜣb[/t] (U 23), ex. [t]Ꜣbdw[/t] 'Abydos'.

sign list.description: cow's skin pierced by an arrow
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]šti[/t] (śti) 'pierce' and derivatives. Also phon. st, ex. Stt '(the goddess) Satis', in spite of the fact that Pyr. write this name Śṯit with [t]ṯ[/t] instead of t.
Cf. [t]šdw[/t] 'water-skin' 'cushion'. Hence phon. [t]šd[/t], exx. [t]šdi[/t] 'draw forth'; [t]wšd[/t] 'address', 'question'.
Cf. mst 'apron of foxes' skins'. Hence phon. ms (mś), exx. msi 'give birth'; msdmt 'black eye paint'.

sign list.description: animal's belly showing teats and tail
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ẖt[/t] 'belly', 'body'. Hence phon. [t]ẖ[/t].
Det. in sd (śd) 'tail'. Hence phon. or phon. det. sd, ex. sdty, a title.
Ideo. in ib 'heart'. Det. in [t]ḥꜢty[/t] 'heart'.
For unknown reason, phon. nfr in nfr 'good', and related words.
Cf. [t]smꜢ[/t] 'lung'. Hence phon. or phon. det. [t]smꜢ[/t] ([t]zmꜢ[/t]) in [t]smꜢ[/t] ([t]zmꜢ[/t]) 'unite' and derivatives.
Ideo. or det. in [t]iꜢt[/t] 'back'. Det. in psd 'back'. By confusion with M 21, phon. det. sm in sm 'succor'.
det. in psd 'back'.

sign list.description: backbone with spinal cord issuing from it
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]imꜢḫ[/t] 'spinal cord', whence also [t]imꜢḫ[/t] 'venerated state'. Rarely det. in [t]psḏ[/t] 'back'.

sign list.description: portion of backbone with spinal cord issuing at both ends
sign list.notes: Ideo. (?) in [t]Ꜣwi[/t] 'stretch out', 'be long'. Possibly hence phon. [t]Ꜣw[/t], exx. [t]Ꜣwt[/t] 'offerings'; [t]fꜢw[/t] 'magnificence'.
Rarely det. in psd 'back'. As det. of [t]šꜥt[/t] 'lust for blood' from an old sign depicting stalks of flax tied together and the bolls cut off.
Ideo. or det. in spr (śpr) 'rib'. Hence phon. spr (śpr) in spr 'approach' and derivatives. Similar signs with which F42 is liable to be confused are D 24, N 11, and N 12.
Det. in [t]spḥt[/t] 'ribs of beef'.

sign list.description: leg-bone with adjoining meat (two different, seldom distinguishable, signs)
sign list.notes: (1) Det. in [t]iwꜥ[/t] 'thigh (of beef)', 'femur'; hence phon. det. of phon. [t]iwꜥ[/t], exx. [t]iwꜥ[/t] inherit'; [t]iwꜥt[/t] 'heritage'. (2) Det. in swt (śwt) 'leg of beef', 'tibia'; hence phon. isw ([t]išw[/t]) in isw, var. O.K. iśw, 'exchange'.
Ideo. or det. in idt (?) 'vulva', 'cow'.

Ideo. in [t]qꜢb[/t] 'intestine'; hence semi-ideo. in [t]m-qꜢb[/t] 'in the midst of'; q([t]Ꜣ[/t])b 'double'. Ideo. and later phon. also in [t]pẖr[/t] 'turn', 'go round' and derivatives; dbn 'go round' and derivatives. Det. (from Dyn. XII) in [t]wḏb[/t], var. wdb, 'turn' and derivative.

sign list.description: alternative to last (N.B. No confusion with M 11 before the Amarna period)
sign list.notes: Use as last.
Use as F 46.
Use as F 46.
In [t]spẖr[/t] , var. O.K. śpẖr, 'copy', 'write out'.

Det. limb, flesh, exx. [t]ꜥt[/t] 'limb'; [t]ḥꜥ[/t] 'flesh'; parts of the body, exx. [t]nḥbt[/t] 'neck', 'shoulder'; mist 'liver'; meat, ex. iwf meat'. As abbrev. is found for [t]ḥꜥw[/t] 'members', 'body'; and for kns 'vagina'. Possibly a different sign when reversed as phon. [t]Ꜣs[/t] or ws in [t]Ꜣst[/t] 'Isis' and Wsir 'Osiris', writings found on the M.K. coffins for some superstitious reasons. In Dyn. XIX or before, this reversed sign changes into the egg H 8 and subsequently below (X 1) becomes a generic det. for goddess.
Det. in Pyr. ḥś 'excrement'.
Ideo. in Pyr. [t]Ꜣ[/t] 'vulture'; hence phon. [t]Ꜣ[/t]. Often indistinguishable from (tyw) G 4.
Phon. [t]ꜢꜢ[/t], ex. [t]mꜢꜢ[/t] 'see'.
Phon. [t]mꜢ[/t], ex, [t]smꜢwy[/t] 'renew'.
Phon. tyw, exx. [t]ẖrtyw-nṯr[/t] 'necropolis workmen'; i-tywn(y) 'welcome ye!'. Often indistinguishable from G 1.
Ideo. in Ḥrw '(the falcon-god) Horus'.
Det. in bik 'falcon'.

sign list.description: falcon of Horus on the standard R 12
sign list.notes: Det. in the O.K. writing Ḥrw 'Horus'. Hence, in O.K. and later often archaistically det. of gods, ex. I͗mn 'Amun', or of the king, ex nsw 'king'. So too regularly in hieratic, while hieroglphic prefers A 40. Also ideo. in pronouns of 1st pers. sing. when the king is speaking, exx. i, wi, 'I', 'me'.

Ideo. for the god of the XIIth nome of Upper Egypt, whose name has been inferred from somewhat complicated data to read [t]ꜥnty[/t] '[t]ꜥAnty[/t]', meaning perhaps literally 'he with the claw(s)'. This god occurs also in other parts of Upper Egypt, particularly in the XVIIIth nome, where his name was possibly read differently. Closely connected was also a biune god [t]ꜥntywy[/t] '[t]ꜥAntywey[/t]' worshipped in the Xth nome and elsewhere, whom the Greeks equated with their mythical giant Antaeus.

Use as last.
For as old symbol of the West, see R 13. For see O 10.

sign list.description: falcon of Horus on he sign for gold S 12
sign list.notes: In title of the king Ḥr (or bik?) n nbw 'Horus (or falcon?) of gold'.

sign list.description: falcon of Horus bearing the sun N 5 on head
sign list.notes: In [t]Rꜥ-Ḥr-Ꜣḫty[/t] '(the composite god) Re-Harakhti'.

sign list.description: falcon on a special sared bark
sign list.notes: Det. in Skr (Zkr) '(the god) Sokar'. Also det. in [t]ḥnw[/t] 'the ḥnw-bark (of Sokar)'.
Det. in [t]ꜥšm[/t] (also [t]ꜥẖm[/t], [t]ꜥḫm[/t]) 'divine image'; also in [t]šnbt[/t] 'breast'.

sign list.description: archaic image of falcon with flagellum S 45
sign list.notes: Like G 11, det. in [t]Ꜣḫm[/t] 'divine image'.

sign list.description: archaic image of falcon with the double plumes S 9
sign list.notes: Ideo. in Ḥr [t]Nḫn[/t](y) '(the god) Horus of Nekhen', i.e. of Hieraconpolis. Det. in Spdw (Śpdw) '(the god) Sopd'.
Det. in Pyr. nrt 'vulture'; hence phon. det. nr, ex. nrw 'terror'. For obscure reason in mwt 'mother', Copt. maau; hence phon. mt, exx. [t]ꜥḫmt[/t] 'river-bank', mtn 'road'.
Ideo. in Mwt '(the goddess) Mut'.

sign list.description: the vulture-goddess Nekhbet and the cobra-goddess Wadjet on baskets V 30
sign list.notes: In nbty 'Two-Ladies', title of the king.
Phon. m.
Phon. mm ex, tmm 'not having been'. In Dyn XVIII seems to be used for im 'therein'.

sign list.description: combination of G 17 and D 37 (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Phon. m (originally mi), ex. mhy 'be neglectful'. See D 3 and D 38.

sign list.description: combination of G 17 and D 36 (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Use as last.
Ideo. in [t]nḥ[/t] 'the [t]nḥ-bird'. Phon. [t]nḥ[/t], exx. [t]nḥi[/t] 'pray'; [t]nḥḥ[/t] 'eternity'. Some sculptors assimilate this sign to G 1 or G 43.
Phon. [t]ḏb[/t] in [t]ḏbt[/t], var. N.K. dbt, 'brick'.
Phon. or phon. det. [t]rḫ[/t](y)t in [t]rḫyt[/t] 'common folk'.

sign list.description: lapwing with wings twisted around one another
sign list.notes: Use as last.
Ideo. or semi-ideo. in [t]Ꜣḫ[/t] 'spirit', 'spirit-like nature'. Hence semi-phon. [t]Ꜣḫ[/t] 'be glorious', 'beneficial' and derivatives.

sign list.description: sacred ibis on the standard R 12
sign list.notes: Det. in hb 'ibis'. Det in Ḏḥwty '(the god) Thoth'.
Use as last, but very rarely without the standard.
Det. in [t]dšr[/t] 'flamingo'. Hence semi-phon. [t]dšr[/t] in [t]dšr[/t] 'red' and derivatives.
Cf. O.K. gmt 'the gmt-bird'. Hence, phon. gm, exx. gmi 'to find'; [t]gmḥ[/t] 'look at'.
Ideo. in [t]bꜢ[/t] 'soul (in bird form)'. Hence phon. [t]bꜢ[/t], exx. [t]bꜢk[/t] 'servant'; [t]ḫbꜢ[/t] 'destroy'. In group writing with single stroke, after minature or is used for b.
In [t]bꜢw[/t] 'spirits', 'might'.
Det. in bnw (bynw) 'phoenix'. A very similar bird is det. in [t]šnty[/t] 'heron'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]bꜥḥi[/t] 'be inundated'.
Det. in Pyr. śdꜢ 'the śdꜢ-bird'. Hence phon. det. in [t]sdꜢ[/t] 'tremble'; [t]sdꜢdꜢ[/t] 'tremble'.
Det. in niw 'ostrich'.
Phon. [t]ꜥq[/t], exx. [t]ꜥq[/t] 'enter'; [t]ꜥqw[/t] 'revenue', 'provisions'.

sign list.description: swallow or martin (Note the swallow tail)
sign list.notes: Phon. wr, exx. wr 'great'; [t]wrḥ[/t] 'anoint'. A similar sign is det. in mnt 'swallow'.
Det. small, exx. [t]nḏs[/t] (nḏś) 'small'; [t]ḥns[/t] 'narrow'; bad, defective, exx. bin 'bad'; [t]šw[/t] 'empty'; mr 'ill', 'diseased'; [t]Ꜣq[/t] 'perish'.

Det. in O.K. gb 'the gb-goose'; hence semi-phon. gb in Gb, var. Gbb, '(the earth-god) Geb'. Det. in r, trp, names of kinds of geese; also in [t]Ꜣpd[/t] 'bird', 'goose'. This type may be employed in place of the more exact G 39 in words containing [t]sꜢ[/t] ([t]zꜢ[/t]), except when the originals clearly mark the pintain. It may be employed for the indeterminate birds serving as phon. det. in [t]wfꜢ[/t] 'talk'; wsf 'be idle'; wdf 'delay'; and [t]ḥtm[/t] 'perish'. Lastly, it may be used for the generalized det. of birds and insects found in hieratic, exx. [t]ṯnḥr[/t] 'hawk'; niw 'ostrich'; [t]snḥmw[/t] 'locusts'.

Det. in st (zt, perhaps for [t]zꜢt[/t]) 'pintail duck'. Hence phon. [t]sꜢ[/t] ([t]zꜢ[/t]), exx. [t]sꜢ[/t] 'son'; [t]sꜢw[/t] 'beam', 'plank'; [t]ḥsꜢt[/t] 'the divine ḥsꜢt-cow'. This type may, if preferred, be employed in the place of G 38 in the indefinite uses where the actual nature of the bird in question is unknown.

Ideo. in Pyr. [t]pꜢ[/t] 'fly'. Hence phon. [t]pꜢ[/t], exx. [t]pꜢ[/t] 'the'; [t]spꜢ[/t] 'centipede'. In group-writing is used for p. In Dyn. XII is occasionally used for G 41. In hieratic is always replaced by G 41, as also oaccasionally in hieroglyphic.

Det. in [t]ḫni[/t] 'alight', 'halt'; hence phon. det. [t]ḫn[/t], ex. [t]ḫn[/t] 'speech', 'sentence'. For unknown reasons, phon. or phon. det. qmi in qmyt 'gum'; phon. det. [t]sḥw[/t] in [t]sḥwy[/t] 'collect'. The combination is used to show that is the throw-stick T 14, not the identically shaped warrior's club, served as det. in [t]qmꜢ[/t] 'throw', whence [t]qmꜢ[/t] 'create'; also in mtn , O.K. [t]mṯn[/t], 'nomad hunter', whence phon. det. [t]ṯn[/t], tn, exx. [t]mṯn[/t] 'road'; [t]ṯni[/t], var. tni, 'distinguish'. Before Dyn. XVIII is sometimes used for G 40 in hieroglyphic, as always in hieratic, where it often serves, like G 38, as an indefinite det. for birds.
Ideo. in [t]wšꜢ[/t] 'fatten'; also in [t]ḏf[/t]([t]Ꜣ[/t]) 'provisions'.

For unknown reason, phon. w.
For , the hieroglyphic adaption of the hieratic abbreviated forn of G 43, see Z 7.

sign list.description: two quail chicks G 43 as monogram
sign list.notes: Phon. ww, ex. [t]pḥww[/t] 'end'.
Phon. [t]wꜥ[/t], ex. [t]wꜥw[/t] 'soldier'.
Phon. [t]mꜢw[/t], ex. m [t]mꜢwt[/t] 'anew'.
Ideo. in [t]ṯꜢ[/t] 'nestling'. Hence phon. [t]ṯꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ṯꜢy[/t] 'male'; [t]ṯnṯꜢt[/t] 'baldachin'. In group-writing ( with single stroke) is used for [t]ṯ[/t].
Det. in [t]sš[/t] ([t]zš[/t]?) 'nest'. Sometimes written with a single duckling.

sign list.description: ducks' heads protruding form a pool
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]sš[/t] ([t]zš[/t]?) 'bird-pool', 'nest'.
In [t]rḫty[/t] 'fuller', 'washerman'.
Det. in [t]ḥꜢm[/t] 'catch fish'.
Det. in snm (śnm) 'feed' (trans. vb.).

sign list.description: human headed bird preceded by R 7 (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Ideo in [t]bꜢ[/t] 'soul'.
Det. in [t]wšn[/t] 'wring neck of (birds)', 'offer'. For unknown reason, phon. or phon. det. in [t]snḏ[/t], var. Pyr. śnḏ, later var. snd, 'fear' and derivatives.

In formula of offering as abbrev. of [t]Ꜣpdw[/t] 'fowl'. det in [t]wšn[/t] 'wring neck of (birds)', 'offer'. This type may be used for H1 H 2 in transcribing hieratic [t]mꜢꜥ[/t] when the crest is absent.

Phon. det. [t]mꜢꜥ[/t], exx. [t]mꜢꜥ[/t] 'temple' (of head), cf. [t]mꜢꜥ[/t] 'real'. Also phon. or phon. det. [t]wšm[/t], exx. [t]wšm[/t] 'ear (of corn)'; [t]wšmw[/t] 'vessel (for beer)'. From Dyn. XII in place of H2 H 3 as phon. pq ([t]pꜢq[/t]) in pqt 'fine linen'.
Phon. det. [t]pꜢq[/t] (pq), ex. [t]pꜢq[/t] 'pꜢq-cake'.
Phon. det. nr, ex. nrw 'terror'. From Dyn. XVIII sportive writing in [t]rmṯ[/t] 'people'.
Det. wing, ex. [t]ḏnḥ[/t], var. [t]dnḥ[/t], 'wing'; fly, exx. [t]ꜥẖi[/t] 'fly'; [t]pꜢ[/t] 'fly'.

Ideo. in [t]šwi[/t] 'feather'. Hence phon. [t]šw[/t], ex. Šw '(the air-god) Shu'. Ideo. as substitute for H6 C 10, in [t]mꜢꜥt[/t] 'truth'; in the adjective [t]mꜢꜥ[/t] 'true' and related words H6 is not written, nor has it been found in M.E. hieratic in any words from this stem.
With one or two strokes at side in M.E. hieratic for words from the stem [t]šw[/t].
Phon. [t]šꜢ[/t] in ŠꜢt '(the land) Shat'.

Det. in [t]swḥt[/t] (śwḥt) 'egg'. The hieratic contraction of G 39 found in the inverted M.K method of expressing filiation appears in Dyn.XIX hieroglyphic as the egg ; that sign may be conventionally used in transcribing the instances in M.K. hieratic. In [t]pꜥt[/t] 'patricians', 'mankind' is perhaps derived from an earlier sign for a clod of earth.
Det. in [t]ḥntꜢsw[/t] 'lizard'; [t]ꜥš[/t]([t]Ꜣ[/t]) 'lizard'. From the latter, phon. [t]ꜥšꜢ[/t] in [t]ꜥšꜢ[/t] 'many' and the related words.
Ideo. or det. in [t]štyw[/t] 'turtle'.

Ideo. or det. crocodile, exx. [t]msḥ[/t] ([t]mzḥ[/t]) 'crocodile'; [t]ḫnty[/t] 'crocodile'; however, for the god Sobek the sign I 5* or I 4 is perhaps invariably used. Det. greedy, in skn 'lust after'; [t]ḥnt[/t] 'be greedy'; perhaps also in [t]ꜥẖm[/t] 'voracious (?) spirit'; aggression in [t]Ꜣd[/t] 'be aggressive', 'angry'. For obscure reason, phon. it in ity 'sovereign'.
Ideo or det. in Sbk (Śbk) '(the crocodile-god) Sobek'.
Det. in [t]sꜢq[/t] (śꜢq) 'collect', 'gather together'.

sign list.description: archaic stone (?) image of a crocodile
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in Sbk (Śbk) '(the crocodile-god) Sobek'.
Cf. ikm 'shield'. Hence (?) phon. km, exx. Kmt 'Eypt'; skm 'grey-haired'.
Det. in Ḥqt '(the frog-goddess) Heket. From Dyn. XVIII of XIX sometimes as sportive ideo. for [t]wḥm[/t] [t]ꜥnḫ[/t] 'repeating life' as epithet after personal name.
Cf. the O.K. name of a man Ḥfnr, i.e. 'Tadpole'. Hence phon. [t]ḥfn[/t] in [t]ḥfn[/t] 'one hundred thousand', plur. var. Dyn. XIX [t]ḥfnw[/t].

Ideo. perhaps in the name of the XIIth nome of Upper Egypt 𓈋𓆑𓊾𓈈Ḏw-ft ‘Mountain of the Horned Viper’, for which a rare var. with 𓆑𓏏 [t]ft[/t] occurs; cf. also demotic fy ‘viper’. Hence phon. f. For 𓊥 see P 9. For 𓋵 see S 30. For 𓍚 see U 35.

Cf. Pyr.𓆓𓏤 [t]ḏ[/t] var. 𓆓𓏏𓆘 [t]ḏt[/t] 'cobra'. Hence phon. [t]ḏ[/t]. Sometimes also, by false archaism, for 𓂧 [t]d[/t].
For 𓇆 see M 14. For 𓌌 see T 5. For 𓎓 see V 21.

Phon. [t]ḏd[/t], ex. 𓎗𓅱𓆕𓏏𓏛 [t]wḏdt[/t] 'what had been commanded'.
For 𓌍 see T 6.

sign list.description: cobra (erect as on the forehead of the Pharaoh)
sign list.notes: Det. in [t]iꜥrt[/t] 'uraeus'. Det. goddesses, especially those to whom the appearance of a snake was attributed, exx. [t]WꜢḏyt[/t] '(the goddess) Wadjet'; Nsrt (Nzrt) '(the goddess) Nesret'.

sign list.description: cobra I 12 on the basket V 30
sign list.notes: Det. goddess, exx. [t]WꜢḏ[/t](y)t 'Wadjet'; ntrt 'goddess'. As an element in the royal title see G 16.
Det. snake, exx [t]ḥfꜢw[/t] 'serpent'; [t]ḏdft[/t] 'snake'; possibly also det. worm, but it is doubtful if [t]ḏdft[/t] ever had that usually attributed meaning.
Use as last.

sign list.notes: Det. in Ḥdw 'the buri-fish'. Hence phon. [t]ꜥd[/t] ([t]ꜥḏ[/t]?) in the title [t]ꜥḏ[/t](?)-mr, var. [t]ꜥd[/t]-mr, 'administrator (of a province)', probably lit. 'excavator of canal(s)'.

sign list.category_group: K, Fishes and parts of fishes
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ẖꜢt[/t] 'oxyrhynchus'. Hence phon. [t]ẖꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ẖꜢt[/t] 'corpse'; [t]ẖꜢrt[/t], var. [t]ḫꜢrt[/t], 'widow'.

sign list.category_group: K, Fishes and parts of fishes
sign list.notes: Phon. det. bs (bz) in bs, var. O.K. ibz, 'introduce', 'enter'. A very similar fish is used as generic det. fish, ex. rmw 'fish'; fishy smell, ex. [t]ḫnš[/t] 'stink'.

sign list.category_group: K, Fishes and parts of fishes
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]nšmt[/t] 'fish-scale'.

sign list.category_group: K, Fishes and parts of fishes
sign list.notes: Det. of [t]špt[/t] 'be discontented'.
Ideo. in [t]ḫprr[/t] 'dung-beetle'. Hence phon. [t]ḫpr[/t] in [t]ḫpr[/t] 'become' and derivatives.
Ideo in bit 'bee'; also in bit 'honey'. Hence phon. bit in bit(y) 'king of Lower Egypt'.
Det. in [t]ꜥff[/t] 'fly'.
Det. in [t]snḥm[/t] (Pyr. [t]znḥm[/t]) 'locust'.
Det. in [t]spꜢ[/t] (Pyr. [t]zpꜢ[/t]) 'centipede'.
For unknown reason, phon. [t]ḫꜢ[/t], in M.E. only in [t]ḫꜢt[/t], var. [t]ḫꜢwt[/t], 'table of offerings'.
Ideo. in Srqt '(the scorpion goddess) Serqet', full name in Pyr. [t]Śrqt-ḥtw[/t] 'she who-relieves-the-wind-pipe'.

Det. tree, exx. nht 'sycamore-fig', 'tree', plur. often nhwt; mnw 'trees'; nbs 'Christ's thorn-tree', 'nebq-tree'; [t]iꜢm[/t], varr. Pyr. [t]iꜢm[/t], im([t]Ꜣ[/t]), unidentified tree. From this last, phon. [t]iꜢm[/t], im--writings with are best transcribed [t]iꜢm[/t]--exx. [t]iꜢmt[/t] 'charm', 'favor'; [t]iꜢm[/t](w) 'tent'. The rather similar sign which serves as det. in [t]mꜥr[/t] 'fortunate' may well depict a quite different object.

Det. plant, flower, exx. [t]iꜢrw[/t] 'reeds'; [t]ḥrrt[/t] 'flower'. From [t]ḥni[/t] 'rush', phon. [t]ḥn[/t], exx. [t]ḥnw[/t] 'vessel'; [t]ḥnskt[/t] 'lock' (of hair). Det. in isi 'be light' (perhaps like isw reeds); hence phon. det. is, exx. isy, var. O.K. iz, 'tomb', 'chamber'; iswt 'old times'. From 'reed (see on M 17) rarely as sportive writing for i 'I', 'my'; hence also for as det. ex. s 'man'. From Dyn XVIII on sometimes as faulty transcription of hieratic T 24 in [t]iḥwty[/t] 'tenant farmer'.

Ideo. in [t]ḫt[/t] 'wood', 'tree'; hence phon. [t]ḫt[/t], exx. [t]ḫtyw[/t] 'terrace'; [t]nḫt[/t] 'strong'. Det. wood, ex. hbny 'ebony'; wooden objects, exx. [t]wḫꜢ[/t] 'column'; qniw 'palanquin'. Vertically in [t]ḏꜥr[/t], var. [t]ḏꜥ[/t], 'search out', lit. perhaps 'harpoon' (vb.); here it is probably corruption of an old sign.

sign list.description: palm-branch stripped of leaves and notched to serve as tally
sign list.notes: Det. in rnpi 'be young', 'vigorous'. Hence rnp in rnpt 'year', with ideographically as symbol; with similar sense ideo. in [t]ḥsbt[/t] 'regnal year' and in snf (from śn.nw.f 'its second) 'last year'. Possibly ideo. of time (if not phon. det.) also in tr 'time', 'season', where it usually appears in the form M 5 or M 6. Elsewhere also is an occasionaly substitute for M 5, M 6, or M 7.

With sportive ideographic intention (palm-branch planted in ) in Pyr. tr, var. t(i), 'season'. Hence (see on M 4 for ) becomes in M.E. characteristic det. in tr 'season'. However, M 6 is a commoner substitute for , though interchanges with in some uses really belonging only to the latter, exx. pri 'battlefield'; [t]TꜢ[/t]-mri 'Ta-meri', i.e. Egypt.

With sportive intention in Pyr. tr 'season'. In M.E. det. in tr 'season'. Hence phon. det. tr, ti, exx. tr 'pray'; [t]ḥtr[/t] 'assess' (taxes); also phon. det. ri, exx. pri battlefield'; [t]TꜢ[/t]-mri 'Ta-meri', i.e. Egypt.
With sportive ideographic intention in Pyr. rnpi 'be young', 'vigorous'. Hence, in M.E., ideo. or det. in rnpi 'be young' and derivatives.

Ideo. in [t]šꜢ[/t] 'lotus pool', 'meadow'. Hence phon. [t]šꜢ[/t], exx. [t]šꜢ[/t] 'appoint', 'command'; [t]šꜢd[/t] 'dig'. In group-writing or is used for [t]š[/t]. From Pyr. [t]iꜢḫi[/t] 'be inundated', ideo. or semi-ideo. in [t]Ꜣḫt[/t] 'inundation season'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]sšn[/t], var. Pyr. [t]zššn[/t], 'lotus'.
Det. in [t]nḥbt[/t] 'lotus-bud'.
Ideo. or det. in wdn 'offer'. In late Dyn. XVIII also erroneously in place of F 46 as det. in w([t]Ꜣ[/t])[t]ḏbw[/t] 'shores'.

sign list.description: leaf, stalk and rhizome of lotus
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ḫꜢw[/t] nw [t]sšn[/t] 'lotus plants'. Hence phon. [t]ḫꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ḫꜢ[/t] 'thousand'; [t]sḫꜢ[/t] 'remember'. In group-writing or is used for [t]ḫ[/t].

Ideo. in [t]wꜢḏ[/t] 'papyrus column', cf. Pyr. [t]wꜢḏ[/t] 'papyrus'. Hence phon. [t]wꜢḏ[/t] in [t]wꜢḏ[/t] 'be green' and derivatives. From M.K., phon. w([t]Ꜣ[/t])[t]ḏ[/t] as substitute for V 24, exx. sw([t]Ꜣ[/t])[t]ḏ[/t] 'hand over', 'bequeath'; w([t]Ꜣ[/t])[t]ḏḥ[/t], var. Pyr. [t]wdḥ[/t], 'pour out'.
Phon. [t]wꜢḏ[/t], w([t]Ꜣ[/t])[t]ḏ[/t], exx. [t]WꜢḏ[/t]-wr 'the sea', lit. 'the great green'; sw([t]Ꜣ[/t])[t]ḏ[/t] 'hand over', 'bequeath'.

sign list.description: clump of papyrus with buds bent down
sign list.notes: Det. papyrus and watery regions, exx. [t]idḥw[/t] 'swamps' (of the Delta); [t]ḏyt[/t] 'papyrus marsh'. Phon. det. [t]wꜢḫ[/t] in [t]wꜢḫ[/t](y) 'hall of the Inundation' from the Pyr. stem [t]iꜢḫi[/t], whence [t]Ꜣḫ[/t] 'thicket' (of papyrus). Hence phon. [t]Ꜣḫ[/t] (or ideo?) in [t]Ꜣḫ[/t]-bit 'Chemmis' (a Delta place), possibly understood as 'Papyrus-thicket of the King of Lower Egypt'. Det. in [t]TꜢ-mḥw[/t] 'Lower Egypt', 'the Delta', whence [t]mḥ[/t]-s 'the crown of Lower Egypt'.

Phon. [t]ḥꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ḥꜢ[/t] 'would that!'; [t]ḥꜢq[/t] 'capture'. In group-writing or is [t]ḥ[/t]. As O.K. det. in [t]TꜢ-mḥw[/t] 'the Delta' and related words is often replaced in M.E. by M 15, but exx. with are still fairly common, exx. [t]TꜢ-mḥw[/t] 'the Delta'; [t]mḥ[/t]-s 'crown of Lower Egypt'.
Ideo. in i 'reeds'. Hence phon. i.
In ii 'come' and the related words.

sign list.description: heaped conical cakes between reed M 17 and sign like U 36
sign list.notes: Det. in [t]ꜥꜢbt[/t] 'offering', 'pile of offerings' and the related verb.
Ideo. or det. in [t]sḫt[/t] (śḫt) 'marshland', 'country' and its derivative [t]sḫty[/t] 'peasant'. Occasionally phon. sm (śm) like M 21, ex. sm 'occupation', 'pastime'.

sign list.description: like the last, but with a loop at the side
sign list.notes: Ideo. or semi-ideo. In sm, var. Pyr. śm 'herb', 'plant'. Hence phon. sm (śm), ex. sm 'succour'.

Cf. Pyr 𓈖𓐍𓃀𓏏𓇑 [t]nḫbt[/t] 'germination', 'shooting up'. Hence phon. 𓇑𓃀𓏏𓅐𓎟 [t]nḫb[/t] in 𓈖𓐍𓃀𓇑𓏏𓅐 [t]Nḫbt[/t] '(the vulture goddess) Nekhbet'.
For , two rushes with shoots, Cf. nnt 'rushes'. Hence is phon. nn, exx. nn 'this'; nni 'be weary'.

sign list.description: plant regarded as typical of Upper Egypt (probably form of M 26, but without flowers)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in swt (śwt) 'the swt-plant'. Hence phon. sw (św), ex. swt 'but'. The word 'king of Upper Egypt' probably originally read ni-śwt 'he who belongs to the swt-plant', but before M.K. had become nsw (nzw); 'kingship' is perhaps to be read nsyt. Sometime is inaccurately used for M 24 or M 26. In group-writing stands for s.
With sportive pictoral intention (plant śwt growing from mouth r), phon. rśw in Pyr. rśwt 'South' and the related words. In M.E. 'South' is rsy.
Faulty writing either for words connected with rswt 'South', ex. rsyw 'southerners', or for words connected with Šmꜥw 'Upper Egypt', ex. Šmꜥ 'Upper Egyptian corn'.

sign list.description: sedge (?) growing from a sign for land resembing N 17
sign list.notes: Probably as a flowering specimen of M 23, ideo in Šmꜥw 'Upper Egypt', the reading of which is given by [t]šmꜥ[/t] 'make music'. Hence phon. [t]šmꜥ[/t] in [t]šmꜥyt[/t] 'chantress', 'singer'.
In Šmꜥ(w) 'Upper Egypt'. Also phon. [t]šmꜥ[/t] in [t]šmꜥyt[/t] 'chantress', 'singer'.
In the title wr [t]mḏw[/t] Šmꜥ(w) 'greatest of the tens of Upper Egypt'.

sign list.description: pods from some sweet smelling tree
sign list.notes: Cf. [t]nḏm[/t] '[t]nḏm[/t]-tree'. Hence semi-phon. [t]nḏm[/t] in [t]nḏm[/t] 'sweet' and the related words. The tree or wood [t]ssnḏm[/t] is possibly a later deformation of an O.K. word śśḏ or [t]ššḏm[/t].
Ideo. or det. in bnr 'sweet' and derivatives.

sign list.description: stylized rhizome of a lotus (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Det. in rd 'grow'.
Use as last. A similar sign sometimes in hieratic erroneously borrowed from rd 'grow' in r(w)d 'be strong'.

sign list.description: grains of corn (also written vertically or grouped)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in it 'barley', 'corn' and its varieties it [t]Mḥ[/t] 'Lower Egyptian corn' and it Šmꜥ 'Upper Egyptian corn'. Det. corn, ex. Npri (the grain-god) Nepri'.
Ideo. or det. in bdt, var. bty, 'emmer'.
Det. in [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t] 'heaps'; also in wbn 'overflow'.

sign list.description: bundle of flax stems showing the bolls (sometimes misinerpreted)
sign list.notes: Phon. [t]ḏr[/t], exx. [t]ḏr[/t] 'since'; [t]nḏri[/t] 'hold fast'. Det. in [t]dmꜢ[/t] 'bind together'.

sign list.description: bundle of flax stems (O.K. form of M 36)
sign list.notes: Phon. [t]ḏr[/t] like M 36.

sign list.description: bundle of flax (O.K.; specialized variant of M 37)
sign list.notes: Det. in O.K. [t]mḥꜥ[/t] (?), var. Dyn. XII [t]mꜥḥ[/t] (?), [t]mḥ[/t] (?), 'flax' and in [t]dmꜢ[/t] 'bind together'.
Det. vegetable offerings, ex. rnpt 'vegetables', 'fruit'.
Cf. isw 'reeds'. Hence phon. is (iz), exx. is (iz) 'tomb'; iswt 'crew'.

sign list.description: log of wood stripped of its branches (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Det. wood, exx. [t]ꜥš[/t] 'cedar' (properly 'pine' or 'fir'); [t]wꜥn[/t] 'juniper (?)'; mr(w) 'meru-wood'.

Phon. wn, exx. [t]wnḏw[/t] 'short-horned cattle'; [t]ḥwn[/t] 'be young'; wnm 'eat'. Not distinguished from Z 11 in the earliest hieratic, and replaced by the latter sign in M.K. hieratic, as also regularly in later hieroglyphic.
Det. vine in i([t]Ꜣ[/t])r(r)t 'vine'; various notions connected with the vine, exx. irp 'wine'; [t]kꜢmy[/t] 'gardener'; fruit generally, exx. [t]dꜢb[/t] 'figs'; [t]išd[/t] '[t]išd[/t]-fruit'.
Det. in srt 'thorn'. Possibly it is the same sign, if not a mere triangle, which serves as ideo. or det. in spd (śpd) 'sharp' and the related words.

Ideo. or det. in pt 'sky'. det. sky, exx. Nwt '(the sky goddess) Nut'; [t]ḥrt[/t] 'heaven', lit. 'the distant one'; high, in [t]ꜥḫi[/t] 'hang'. In [t]I͗n-ḥrt[/t] '(the god) Onuris' is a later interpretation, since the name originally meant 'he who fetched the distant one (fem.)'. From [t]ḥrt[/t] 'heaven', phon. [t]ḥry[/t], [t]ḥrw[/t] in [t]ḥry[/t] 'above' and the related words. In two words for 'gate' is derived from earlier signs for gateway, namely in rwty 'the double gate' and in ht, var. hyt, 'portal', whence the title smsw hyt 'elder of the portal'. There is perhaps a similar contamination in [t]hꜢt[/t] 'ceiling'.

sign list.description: sky with a broken (?) was-scepter S 40 (?) suspended from it (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Det. night, exx. [t]grḥ[/t] 'night'; [t]wḫ[/t] 'night'; darkness, exx. kkw 'darkness'; [t]ꜥḫḫw[/t] 'dusk'.
Use as last.

sign list.description: moisture falling from the sky (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. dew, rain, exx. idt, var. [t]iꜢdt[/t], abbrev. , 'dew'; [t]šnyt[/t] 'rain-storm'.

Ideo. or det. in [t]rꜥ[/t] 'sun', 'day'; hrw 'day'; in dates reads sw. Det. sun or actions of sun, exx. [t]šw[/t] 'sun'; wbn 'rise'; day, exx. sf 'yesterday'; [t]wrš[/t] 'spend all day'; time generally, exx. wnwt 'hour'; [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t] 'period'; (n)[t]ḥḥ[/t] 'eternity'. For group-writing of over see N 23.
Ideo. or det. in [t]rꜥ[/t] 'sun'.
Abbrev. for [t]ẖrt[/t]-hrw 'day-time', 'course (of day)', lit. 'what belongs to the day'.
Det. (or ideo.) sunshine, exx. [t]Ꜣḫw[/t] (Pyr. [t]iꜢḫw[/t]) 'sunshine'; [t]psḏ[/t] 'shine'; wbn 'rise'. From this last, phon. wbn in wbnw 'wound'. Phon. [t]ḥnmmt[/t] in 'the sun-folk' of Heliopolis.

sign list.description: moon with its lower half obscured (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]psḏntyw[/t], var. psdn, var. Pyr. pśḏtyw, 'New-moon festival'. Hence phon. det. [t]psḏ[/t] in [t]psḏt[/t] 'divine ennead', 'company of nine gods'. This sign is liable to confusion with the loaf X 6.
Use as last.

sign list.description: Crescent moon (also vertically or vertically and reversed when used as det.)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]iꜥḥ[/t] 'moon'; hence phon. det. or abbrev. in [t]wꜥḥ[/t] 'carob beans.' Combined with N 14, ideo. in [t]Ꜣbd[/t] 'month'; for the reading cf. an O.K. personal name [t]Ꜣbdw[/t] and Sa`idic ebot 'month'; in dates abbreviated as , ex. [t]Ꜣbd[/t] 3 'month 3.' In abbrev. [t]šsp[/t] 'palm' (as measure) the sign has doubtless a different pictorial origin. In some inscriptions is written for spr, F 42.
In [t]iꜥḥ[/t] 'moon'.

sign list.description: combination of half of N 11 and N 14
sign list.notes: Ideo. in ...nt 'half-month festival'.

Ideo. or det. in [t]sbꜢ[/t], var. Pyr. śbꜢ, 'star'; hence phon. or phon. det. [t]sbꜢ[/t] (śbꜢ), 'teach' (with derivatives); [t]sbꜢ[/t] 'door'. Det. star, constellation, exx. [t]Msḫtyw[/t] 'the Great Bear'; Spdt 'Sothis'; time as indicated by stars, exx. [t]Ꜣbd[/t] 'month', see N 11; wnwt (1) 'hour', (2) 'priesthood'. Also semi-phon. [t]dwꜢ[/t], exx. [t]dwꜢt[/t] 'morning'; [t]dwꜢ[/t] 'adore' (in the morning). In the word 'netherworld' (originally the place of the morning twilight, popularly known as 'the Duat' and in this work still translated [t]dwꜢt[/t]) the very common Pyr var. [t]dꜢt[/t] probably indicates that the w had fallen and that the pronunciation already approximated to the Old Coptic te, tei.
Ideo. in d(w)[t]Ꜣt[/t] 'netherworld', see N 14, at end.

sign list.description: flat alluvial land with grains of sand N 33 beneath it
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]tꜢ[/t] 'earth', 'land'. Hence phon. [t]tꜢ[/t] (rare), ex, [t]sštꜢ[/t] 'mystery', 'secret'. In group-writing with and is t. Det. land, in [t]ḏt[/t] 'estate', whence also in [t]ḏt[/t] 'eternity'; [t]ḏt[/t] 'serf'.
Use as last.

Ideo. in iw 'island'. In group-writing with and is phon. i, ex. I͗rt 'Yareth' (Syrian place-name). Det. desert or foreign country, exx. [t]Ꜣḫt[/t] 'horizon', more exactly the land of the sun-rise; Ṯḥnw 'Libya'; Stt 'Asia'; cf. too D 8. Different signs, but with similar outline, are (1) the garment, see after S 26; (2) the cake, see after X 4; (3) the oval, see Z 8.
In [t]Ḥr-Ꜣḫti[/t], 'Horus-of-the-horizon', 'Harakhti'.

Det. in [t]wḏb[/t] 'sand-bank', 'shore'. Hence phon. [t]wḏb[/t] in var. Pyr. [t]wḏb[/t] 'turn back' and derivatives. From O.K. onward a sign of like appearance is used in [t]ḥb[/t]-sd 'jubilee', 'Sed-festival'.

Det. land, especially in idb 'bank', 'region' (dual idbwy 'the two banks', i.e. 'Egypt'). More widely used in Dyn. XVIII, then often taking the place of earlier N 23, exx. [t]tꜢ[/t] 'earth'; [t]Ꜣḥt[/t] 'fields'; dmi 'town'.

sign list.description: sandy tongue of land (O.K. prototype of both N 20 and N 21)
sign list.notes: In [t]wḏb[/t], see O.K. var. under N 20. det. land, exx. Dyn. III [t]ꜥḥt[/t] 'field'; śḫt 'field'.

sign list.description: irrigation canal (Dyn. XI-XVIII; early identical with, and clearly a mere differentiation of, N 36)
sign list.notes: Det. irrigated land, exx. [t]tꜢ[/t] 'land'; [t]tꜢš[/t] 'boundary'; in Dyn XVIII N 23 tends to be replaced by N 21. In Dyn. XI-XII over is found as det. of time, probably corrupted from over two horizontal strokes as used in words for 'tomorrow' and 'yesterday', exx. tr 'season'; rk 'time'.

sign list.description: land marked out with irrigation runnels
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in sp([t]Ꜣ[/t])t (śpꜢt) 'district', 'nome'; also in [t]ḏꜢtt[/t] (?) 'estate'. Det. province, exx. [t]TꜢ[/t]-wr 'nome of Abydos'; Šmꜥw 'Upper Egypt'; also garden in [t]ḥsp[/t] (Pyr. [t]ḥzp[/t]) 'garden'.

sign list.description: sandy hill country over edge of green cultivation
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫꜢst[/t] (ḫꜢśt) 'hill country', 'foreign land'. Det. desert, exx. smt (zmt) 'desert', 'necropolis'; [t]ḥrt[/t] 'upland tomb'; [t]iꜢbtt[/t] 'east'; also foreign countries, ex. [t]Rṯnw[/t] 'Retjnu', 'Syria'. Ideo. in ḤꜢ (the desert-god) Ha'.

sign list.description: sand-covered mountain over edge of green cultivation
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ḏw[/t] 'mountain', plur. [t]ḏww[/t]. Hence phon. [t]ḏw[/t] (later dw), exx. [t]ḏwi[/t] 'call'; [t]Ꜣbḏw[/t] 'Abydos'; [t]wnḏw[/t] 'short-horned cattle'.
Ideo. in [t]Ꜣḫt[/t] 'horizon' (properly the place in the sky where the sun rises) and its derivatives.

sign list.description: hill over which are the rays of the rising sun
sign list.notes: Ideo. in Pyr. [t]ḫꜥ[/t] 'hill of the sunrise' and in [t]ḫꜥi[/t] 'appear in glory'. Hence phon. [t]ḫꜥ[/t], ex. [t]ḫꜥm[/t], var. [t]ẖꜥm[/t], 'approach'.
Cf. [t]qꜢꜢ[/t] 'hill', 'height'. Hence phon. q.
Ideo. or det. in [t]iꜢt[/t] 'mound'.

Ideo. or det. in [t]wꜢt[/t] 'road' and related words. Det. road, exx. [t]mṯn[/t] 'road'; [t]ḥrt[/t] 'road' (with related words); travel, in [t]ꜥr[/t] 'mount up' and derivatives; position in general, exx. [t]ꜥꜢ[/t] 'here'; r-sy 'entirely'; [t]pfꜢ[/t] 'that'; distance, in [t]ḥnty[/t] 'period'. Abbrev. [t]ḥr[/t] (see [t]ḥrt[/t] 'road' above) in [t]I͗n-ḥrt[/t] '(the god) Onuris'; in [t]ḥrw[/t]-r 'besides'; and for superstitious reasons in place of Ḥr 'Horus' on M.K. coffins; also abbrev. [t]wꜢ[/t] in [t]wꜢ[/t] r 'fall into' a bad state.
Phon. det. in Pyr. śinw 'runners' on account of sin 'clay'. Also as alternative for F 52 in O.K. mḥśḥś 'filthy one'. In M.E. replaced by Aa 2.

sign list.description: grain of sand, pellet, or like.  (For similar signs cf. D 12 and the circle, see after Z 8)
sign list.notes: Det, sand, in [t]šꜥy[/t] 'sand'; metal or mineral (often repeated), exx. nbw 'gold'; msdmt 'black eye-paint', 'kohl'; medicaments, incense, etc. exx. [t]ṯꜢ[/t] 'pellet'; [t]pẖrt[/t] 'medicine', 'prescription'. A sign of like appearance rarely takes the place of dangerous signs such as A 14 in religious documents, exx. [t]ḫftyw[/t] 'enemies'; this practice dates from Pyr. Sometimes is substituted for the plural strokes , exx. gnwt 'annals'; [t]šsrw[/t] 'bags'.

sign list.description: ingot of metal (Dyn. XVIII; in Dyn. XI the sign resembles W 13; in Dyn. III-V it resembles X 3)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in 'copper', early perhaps read [t]biꜢ[/t] and later [t]ḥmt[/t] (?). Det. objects of copper or bronze, exx. [t]ꜥnḫ[/t] 'mirror'; [t]ḫꜥw[/t] 'weapons; minb 'axe'.

Cf. nt 'water'. Hence (?) phon. n. Perhaps phon. n too when used as a substitute for D 35 both in n 'not' and nn 'not'. In [t]ḏt[/t] 'serf' replaces the sign of land N 17, a curious substitution (or error of transcription?) found also in Pyr.

sign list.description: channel filled with water (later form as det. irrigated land N 23)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in mr 'canal', 'channel'. Hence phon. or phon. det. mr in var. mri 'love'; phon. mi, exx. mist 'liver'; [t]miḥꜥt[/t] 'tomb'. Det. rivers, lakes, seas, exx. [t]WꜢḏ[/t]-wr 'the sea', lit. 'the great green'; [t]ḥꜥpy[/t], var. M.K. [t]ḥp[/t], 'the inundation', here early interchanging with N 37. For use with N (35) as det. of names of rivers, lakes, seas from Dyn. XVIII on, see under N 35. Doubtless an irrigation canal when prototype of the later land-sign N 23, see there. In the fem. collective mrt 'weavers' the sign was probably understood as a weaver's reed, though the occasional presence of or may may have indicated the same value mr as in the masc. mr 'friend(s)', 'partisans'.

Ideo. in [t]š[/t]'pool'. Hence phon. [t]š[/t]. Not seldom interchanging in hieroglyphic with N 36, ex. [t]ḥꜥpyw[/t] 'inundations'. Appears to be a sign for irrigated land in śtꜢt 'aurora'; cf. the use of N 36 both as a channel of the Nile and, in its use as the early form of N 23, as an irrigation canal. Sometimes replaced the cake (see after X 4) in spellings of sn 'open'. Occasionally it serves as a large form of the block of stone O 39, ex. inr 'stone'.

sign list.description: garden pool with sloping sides (detailed form of N 37)
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.description: garden pool full of water (alternative of N 37)
sign list.notes: Use as N 37.
In [t]šm[/t] 'go'.

Det. well, ex. [t]ẖnmt[/t] 'well'; pool, marsh, in [t]pḥww[/t] 'limits', 'distant marshlands'. As substitute for the female organ in [t]ḥmt[/t] 'woman', 'wife'. Hence phon. [t]ḥm[/t] , exx. [t]ḥm[/t] 'assuredly'; [t]nḥm[/t] 'rescue'. Also as female organ in 'vulva', and derivatively 'cow', where the reading is more probably idt than [t]ḥmt[/t]; cf. above F 45. For obscure reasons, phon. [t]biꜢ[/t], exx. [t]biꜢ[/t] 'copper'; [t]biꜢ[/t] 'firmament'; for the reading see [t]biꜢw[/t] 'mine'.

sign list.description: well full of water (a common alternative form of last)
sign list.notes: Use as last.

Ideo. in pr 'house', cf. the fem. collective pryt 'houses'. Hence phon. pr in pri 'go forth' and derivatives; only very rarely not initial pr, ex. for [t]ḫpr[/t] 'become'. Det. house, bulding, exx. [t]ꜥt[/t] 'room', 'department'; iwnn 'sanctuary'; [t]ẖnw[/t] 'interior'; [t]mꜥḥꜥt[/t] 'tomb'. Less suitably also in st 'seat', 'place'; nst 'seat' of office; [t]Ꜣḫt[/t] 'horizon'.
In [t]pr-ḥḏ[/t] 'treasury', lit. 'white house'.

sign list.description: combination of O 1, P 8, X 3, and W 22
sign list.notes: In [t]prt-ḫrw[/t] 'invocation offerings'.
Ideo. in h 'room (?)'. Hence phon. h.
Det. in mrrt 'street'; hence phon. or phon. det. mr in Mr-wr 'Menvis-bull'. For unknown reasons, phon. det. nm in nmi 'traverse'; also in nmi 'lowing' of cattle.

Ideo. in [t]ḥwt[/t] 'castle', 'mansion', 'temple', 'tomb'. The full reading [t]ḥwt[/t], possibly later [t]ḥyt[/t], is suggested by the O.K. personal name Ḥwti and by the isolated variant [t]Nbt-ḥyt[/t], together with the Coptic equivalent of the name of the goddess Nephthys. Hence the transliteration [t]ḥwt[/t] has been adoped in Gardiner's grammar except for the divine name [t]Ḥt-ḥr[/t] 'Hathor', where the element [t]ḥat[/t] is clearly in status constructus. However, in one passage of Dyn. XII it is used in [t]ḥtt[/t] 'quarry', giving to the mere value [t]ḥ[/t].
Use as last.
In [t]ḥwt-ꜥꜢt[/t] 'temple', earlier 'castle', lit. 'great castle'.
In [t]Nbt-ḥyt[/t] '(the goddess) Nephthys'.
In [t]Ḥt-ḥr[/t] '(the goddess) Hathor'.
Ideo. in [t]ꜥḥ[/t], var. M.K. [t]iḥ[/t], 'palace'.
In var. of [t]ꜥḥ[/t] 'palace', see last.
Det. in [t]sbḫt[/t] 'gateway' and in the related verb [t]sbḫ[/t] (śbḫ) 'wall in', 'enclose'.
Use as last.

sign list.description: walled enclosure with buttresses, and with the signs W 10 and X 1
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]wsḫt[/t] (wśḫt) 'hall' in palace or temple.
Ideo. or det. in [t]tꜢ[/t] 'curtain(?)' and [t]tꜢyt[/t] 'curtain'. Hence semi-ideo. in the title of the vizier [t]tꜢyty[/t] 'he of the curtain'. For [t]tꜢ[/t]-wr 'larboard' see on S 22.
Use as last.
Ideo. or det. in [t]kꜢ[/t](r)i (Pyr. [t]kꜢr[/t]) 'chapel', 'shrine'.

Det. in Pr-wr 'Great House' name of the pre-dynastic national shrine of Upper Egypt at Hieraconpolis ([t]Nḫn[/t]); also of itrt in itrt [t]šmꜥ[/t](yt) 'the row of Upper Egyptian sanctuaries', as seen at the Sed-festival; hence also as collective term for 'the gods of Upper Egypt'.

Det. sanctuary, exx. itrt 'row of sanctuaries'; [t]ḫm[/t] 'shrine'; especially of the Pr-nw or Pr-nsr (Pr-nzr), names of the pre-dynastic national sanctuary of Lower Egypt at Buto (P). Hence itrt [t]mḥt[/t] 'the row of Lower Egyptian sanctuaries' and collective term for 'the gods of Lower Egypt'; see on O 19.
Ideo. or det. in [t]sḥ-nṯr[/t] ([t]zḥ-nṯr[/t]) 'the divine booth'.

sign list.description: open booth supported by a pole
sign list.notes:
Ideo. or det. in [t]sḥ[/t], var. Pyr. [t]zḥ[/t], 'booth'; hence phon. [t]sḥ[/t] ([t]zḥ[/t]) in [t]sḥ[/t] 'counsel'. In the combination the sign retains a value [t]ḥb[/t] ([t]ḥꜢb[/t]) which it formerly possessed when used alone.
For see W 4.
Ideo. or det. in [t]ḥb[/t]-sd ([t]ḥb[/t]-śd) 'jubilee', 'Sed-festival'.

sign list.description: pyramid with side of surrounding wall
sign list.notes: Det. in mr 'pyramid', 'tomb', and in names of specific royal pyramids, ex. [t]QꜢ-nfr-I͗mnmḥꜢt[/t] 'the pyramid of Amenemhet-is-high-and-beautiful'. Hence also in [t]Mn-nfr[/t] 'Memphis'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]tḫn[/t] 'obelisk'.
Ideo. or det. stela, exx. [t]wḏ[/t] 'stela'; [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t] 'station', 'stela'.
Det. hall of columns, exx. [t]ḏꜢdw[/t] 'hall of columns'; [t]ḫꜢ[/t] 'office'. From last, phon. or phon. det. [t]ḫꜢ[/t] in [t]ḫ(Ꜣ)w(y)[/t] 'night'.
Ideo. in iwn 'column'; for the reading cf. iwnyt 'hall of columns'. Hence phon. iwn, exx. iwnt 'bow'; I͗wnw 'Heliopolis'.

Cf. [t]ꜥꜢ[/t] 'column'. Hence phon. [t]ꜥꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ꜥꜢ[/t] 'great'; [t]ḥꜥꜢ[/t] 'infant'. In group-writing is phon. [t]ꜥ[/t], exx. [t]Tꜥmṯ[/t] 'Taꜥmeti', f. personal name; [t]Ynꜥm[/t] 'Yenoam', Palestinian place-name.
Ideo. or det. in [t]sḫnt[/t] ([t]zḫnt[/t]) 'support' of heaven. For a similar sign, but reversed (with prongs down), see after U 12.
Ideo. or det. in [t]ꜥꜢ[/t] 'door'; hence very rarely phon. [t]ꜥꜢm[/t] ex, [t]ꜥꜢmt[/t] 'Asiatic woman'. det. open, exx. wn 'open'; sn 'open'.
Det. door, gateway, exx. [t]sbꜢ[/t] (śbꜢ) 'door'; [t]sbḫt[/t] 'gateway'.
Det. in [t]srḫ[/t] 'banner' for the Horus name.
Ideo. in s (z) 'bolt'. Hence phon. s (z). Also as substitute for R 22 in Ḫm 'Letopolis', the modern Ausim, NW. of Cairo.

In a number of words implying motion and having s (z) as a characteristic radical, exx. sbi 'go', 'pass', 'send'; si 'perish', later replaced by sbi; ms 'bring', 'offer'; is 'go' (imperative); sy (zy) 'who?', 'what?' There is much confusion in the value of , owing to the tendency (1) to write alone for sb, and (2) to write for simple s.
Ideo. or det. in inb 'wall'. Det. wall, exx. sbty 'surrounding wall'; wmtt 'bulwark', 'fortification'; snb 'overleap' a wall.
Det. overthrow, exx. shn 'overthrow'; [t]sẖnn[/t] 'demolish' a wall; slanting, ex. [t]gsꜢ[/t] 'tilt'.

Det. in qnbt 'corner', 'angle', whence qnbt 'magistrates', lit. perhaps 'those who sit at the corner'. Det. gate, in [t]ꜥrrt[/t] 'gate'; corner (?), in mrrt 'street'. Ideo. or det. in [t]ḥry[/t] (n) tm, an obscure title.

sign list.description: stone slab or brick (sometimes largle like N 37)
sign list.notes: Det. stone and similar, exx. inr 's'tone'; [t]ꜥꜢt[/t] 'valuable stone' for vessels, etc.; dbn 'deben-weight'; [t]ꜥr[/t] 'pebble'; [t]ḏbt[/t] 'brick'.
Det. stairway, exx. rwd 'stairway'; [t]ḫtyw[/t] 'terrace', 'terraced hill'.
Det. stairway, exx. [t]qꜢy[/t] 'ascent', 'high place'; [t]iꜥr[/t] 'ascend'.
Phon. [t]šsp[/t] ([t]šzp[/t]) in [t]šsp[/t], var. Pyr. [t]šzp[/t], 'receive', but early [t]sšp[/t]; cf. [t]sšp[/t] 'daylight'.
Use as last.

sign list.description: emblem erected outside the temple of Min
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]iꜢt[/t] 'office', 'rank'.
Ideo. or det. in ipt 'harem'; [t]ipꜢt[/t] is possibly the fuller form of the same word.
Use as last.

sign list.description: a prehistoric building at Hieraconpolis (Dyn. XVIII form)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]Nḫn[/t] 'Hieraconpolis', i.e. Kom el-Ahmar in Upper Egypt.
Use as last.

Ideo. in niwt 'village'; for the reading cf. Pyr. n(iw)tyw (?) 'those belonging to the lower heaven'. Det. village, town, ex. [t]WꜢst[/t] 'Thebes'; inhabited region, in Kmt 'Egypt', lit. 'the black (land)'; [t]ḏꜢtt[/t](?) 'estate'.

Det. in spt (zpt) 'threshing-floor'. hence phon. or phon. det. sp (zp) in sp 'time', 'occasion' and related words. Note sp sn 'two times' as sign that a word or part of a word is to be repeated in reading, exx. [t]ꜥšꜢ[/t] [t]ꜥšꜢ[/t] 'very often'; [t]ršrš[/t] 'rejoice'.

sign list.description: heap of grain on a raised mud floor
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]šnwt[/t] 'granary'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Det. boat, ship, exx. 𓂧𓊪𓏏𓊛 [t]dpt[/t] 'ship'; 𓎛𓂝𓅱𓊛𓏥 [t]ḥꜥw[/t] 'ships; 𓊢𓂝𓅱𓊛𓏥 [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t] 'ships'; sail, travel by water, exx. 𓈖𓂝𓊛 [t]nꜥi[/t]'sail'; 𓐍𓂧𓊛 [t]ḫdi[/t] 'fare downstream'; also det. in 𓃛𓅱𓊛 [t]iw(y)[/t] 'one wihtout a boat'. As abbrev. the sign presents difficulties; 𓊹𓊛 is doubtless [t]dpt-nṯr[/t] 'the divine bark'; in 𓄓𓊛 'overseer of ships' there is definite evidence in favour of [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t], but possibly [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t] is merely a later writing of, or more recent substitute for, [t]ḥꜥw[/t]; the singular 𓊛'boat' doubtless usually stood for 𓇋𓐛𓅓𓅱𓊛 [t]imw[/t], but once at least represents the much rarer 𓈎𓄿𓈎𓄿𓏲𓊛 [t]ḳꜣḳꜣw[/t].

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Det. in 𓊪𓈖𓂝𓊜 [t]pnꜥ[/t] 'upset', 'overturn'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Det. in 𓏃𓈖𓏏𓊝 [t]ḫnti[/t] 'sail upstream'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in 𓅱𓇋𓄿𓊞 var. 𓊞 [t]wiꜣ[/t] 'sacred bark'. Det. divine boats, exx. 𓎙𓅓𓏏𓊞 [t]mꜥnḏt[/t] 'bark of the dawn'; 𓈖𓈙𓅓𓏏𓊞 [t]nšmt[/t] 'the neshmet-bark', i.e. the sacred boat of Abydus. Also det. sail, when divine journeys are meant, ex. 𓍑𓄿𓊞 [t]ḏꜣi[/t] 'cross' sky, and said of Re.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Semi-ideo. in [t]wḥꜥ[/t] 'fisherman', plur. [t]wḥꜥw[/t], together with the related words.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. [t]ṯꜢw[/t] 'breath', 'wind'. Det. wind, exx. [t]mḥyt[/t] 'north wind'; [t]ḏꜥw[/t] 'storm'; sail, in [t]ḥtꜢw[/t] 'sail'. Ideo. also in nfw 'skipper', late var. nfy.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Phon. [t]ꜥḥꜥ[/t] in 𓂝𓊢𓂝𓂻 var. 𓊢𓂝𓂻 [t]ꜥḥꜥ[/t] 'stand' and derivatives.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Use as last, ex 𓊣𓊛𓏥 [t]ꜥḥꜥw[/t] 'ships'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Det. oar, exx. wsrw 'oars'; [t]ḥpt[/t] 'oar'. Perhaps from a word 'oar' known only from the king's name [t]Nb-ḫrw(?)-Rꜥ[/t] 'Nebkherura' phon. [t]ḫrw[/t], exx. [t]ḫrw[/t] 'voice'; [t]ḫrwy[/t] 'enemy'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: In [t]ḫr[/t](y).fy 'says'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Det. in [t]ḥmw[/t] 'steering oar'; [t]ḥmy[/t] 'steersman'.

sign list.category_group: P, Ships and parts of ships
sign list.notes: Det. in mnit (minit) 'mooring post' and the related words. In hieratic often indistinguishable from T 14 and consequently so usually transcribed.

Ideo. in st, var. Pyr. śt, 'seat', 'place'. Hence phon. st (śt), exx. [t]mꜢst[/t] 'lap'; nmst 'jar'; ws (wś) in Wsir 'Osiris'; [t]Ꜣs[/t] (Ꜣś), in [t]Ꜣst[/t] (Ꜣśt) 'Isis'. From a word [t]ḥtmt[/t] 'chair' (Dyn. XIX) phon. [t]ḥtm[/t], ex [t]ḥtm[/t] 'perish'.
Ideo. in st 'seat' (rare). Phon. ws (wś) in Wsir 'Osiris'.

Cf. p 'base' (for shrine), Ptolemaic p 'seat', Coptic poi 'bench'. Hence phon. p.
For see M 7.
Det. in wsr (wśr) 'head-rest'.
Det. box, chest, exx. hn 'box'; [t]ꜥfdt[/t] 'chest'.
Ideo. or det. in qrsw (qrśw) 'coffin'. Det. in qrs 'bury'.

sign list.description: brazier with flame rising from it
sign list.notes: Det. fire, exx. [t]ḫt[/t] 'fire'; [t]sḏt[/t] 'flame'; heat, exx. [t]rkḥ[/t] 'heat'; [t]tꜢ[/t] 'hote'; cook, etc., exx. psi 'cook'; [t]Ꜣbw[/t] 'brand'; torch, in [t]tkꜢ[/t] 'torch', 'candle'. Also abbrev. for srf (śrf) 'temperature'; nsrsr (nśrśr) in I͗w-nsrsr, a mythical locality.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫꜢwt[/t], varr. [t]ḫꜢt[/t], 'table of offerings'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: table with conventionalized slices of bread
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫꜢy[/t](t), varr. [t]ḫꜢt[/t], 'table of offerings'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: four-legged  table with loaves and libation vase
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]wḏḥw[/t], var. Pyr. [t]wdḥw[/t], 'table of offerings'. Also as abbrev., especially in the title [t]sš[/t] [t]wdḥw[/t] 'scribe of the offering-table'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ḥtp[/t] 'altar'. Hence semi phon. [t]ḥtp[/t] in [t]ḥtp[/t] 'rest', 'be pleased' and derivatives.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: censer for fumigation (after O.K. doubtless misunderstood)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]kꜢp[/t] 'fumigate'. Hence phon. [t]kꜢp[/t] 'harem', 'nursery', 'private apartments'; kp, ex. Kpny 'Byblos', a town in Phoenicia.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: bowl for incense with smoke rising from it
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in sntr 'incense'. Also as equivalent of O.K. W 10* in [t]bꜢ[/t] 'soul'; also in [t]bꜢ[/t] 'ram'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: cloth wound on a pole, emblem of divinity
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]nṯr[/t] 'god'. Hence phon. (semi-ideo.) [t]nṯr[/t], ex. ntry, var. Pyr. [t]nṯr[/t](i), 'divine'. Very rarely det. for a god, ex. Gbb 'Geb'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in bd '(a kind of) natron'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: combination of R 8 and T 28 and N 29
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ẖr(t)-nṯr[/t] 'necropolis'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: column imitating a bundle of stalks tied together
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ḏd[/t] 'djed-column'. Hence phon. [t]ḏd[/t] in var. Pyr. [t]ḏdi[/t] 'be stable', 'enduring' and derivatives. The twofold writing of the sign in the town-name doubtless indicates the change of value from [t]ḏd[/t] to dd.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Det. in [t]iꜢt[/t] 'standard'. Also accompanyng various ideograms for gods, exx. Mnw '(the god) Min'; ḤꜢ '(the god) Ḥa. Cf. also D 29; E 18; G 7; G 26; R 13.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: falcon G 5 on R 12 with feather (O.K. to Dn. XII)
sign list.notes: As emblem of the West, ideo in imnt 'west' and the related words. For the reading compare Pyr. imn 'right', 'right-hand'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: abbrev. of last, omitting falcon and enlarging feather (from Dyn. VI onward)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in imnt 'west' and related words, including wnmy, var. Pyr. wnmi, 'right' hand, side, etc.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: As emblem of the East, ideo. in [t]iꜢbt[/t] 'east' and related words, ex. [t]iꜢby[/t], varr. Pyr. [t]iꜢbi[/t], 'left-hand'. From Dyn. XVIII on, by confusion with U 23, phon. [t]Ꜣb[/t], exx. [t]Ꜣbḏw[/t] 'Abydos'; [t]Ꜣb[/t].n 'has desired'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]wḫ[/t] 'the [t]wḫ[/t]-fetish' of Cusae in Upper Egypt.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: wig, with fillet and plumes, on pole (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Fetish of Abydos, ideo. or det. in [t]TꜢ[/t]-wr 'the nome of Abydos or This'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: the was scepter S 40 with fillet and feather
sign list.notes: As emblem of the Upper Egyptian nome of Hermonthis and its town, ideo. in [t]WꜢst[/t] (WꜢśt), var. dyn. XX Ws(r), 'Thebes'. For [t]iꜢtt[/t] 'milk' see on S 40.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: As emblem of the goddess of writing ideo. in [t]SšꜢt[/t], var. Pyr. ŚšꜢt, late var. [t]Sšt[/t], '(the goddess) Seshat'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: As emblem of the god of Panopolis (Ekhmim) and of Coptus (Qif) ideo. in Mnw '(the god) Min'. The name of Letopolis (Ausim) in the Delta reads Ḫm; from M.K. onwards O 34 is often substituted for R 22 , see on O 34. Hence phon. [t]ḫm[/t] in [t]ḫm[/t] 'shrine'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Use as last.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.description: two bows tied in a package (sometimes also vertically)
sign list.notes: As emblem of the goddess of Sais, ideo. or det. in Nt(Nrt, Nit) '(the goddess) Neith'.

sign list.category_group: R, Temple furniture and sacred emblems
sign list.notes: Use as last.
Ideo. of det. in [t]dꜢiw[/t] 'loin-cloth'.

sign list.description: tie or straps with a different arrangement of the same elements as S34

sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ḥḏt[/t] 'the white crown'. Det. white crown, exx. [t]šmꜥ[/t]-s 'crown of Upper Egypt'; wrrt 'great crown'.
Ideo. or det. [t]ḥḏt[/t] 'white crown'. Det white crown, in wrrt 'great crown'.

Ideo. or det. in [t]dšrt[/t] 'red crown'. Det. red crown, ex. [t]mḥ[/t]-s 'crown of Lower Egypt'. From Pyr. nt 'crown of Lower Egypt' phon. n, rare before Dyn. XVIII. Substituted for L 2 for superstitious reasons in [t]sḏwty[/t] (?) bity 'treasurer of the king of Lower Egypt'; also in n-sw-bit 'king of Upper and Lower Egypt'.
Det. red crown, exx. nt 'net-crown'; [t]mḥ[/t]-s 'crown of Lower Egypt'. very rarely phon. n, like S 3.
Det. double crown in [t]sḫmty[/t] 'the double drown' of Upper and Lower Egypt, lit. 'the two powerful ones'.
Ideo. or det. double crown, exx. [t]sḫmty[/t] 'the double crown'; wrrt 'the great crown'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫprš[/t] 'the blue crown'.
Ideo. or det. in tf 'the atef-crown'.

Use as last.

Ideo. or det. in [t]šndyt[/t], var. Pyr. [t]šnḏwt[/t], 'apron'.

Phon. sf in sf 'yesterday'.
Phon. [t]smꜢ[/t], ex [t]smꜢ[/t] 'fighting bull'.

Ideo. or det. in [t]ṯbt[/t], var. Dyn. XVIII tbt, 'sandal'. Hence semi-phon. or phon. det. [t]ṯb[/t], later tb, in [t]ṯb[/t] 'be shod'; [t]ṯbw[/t] 'sandal-maker'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]ṯbt[/t], var. Dyn. XVIII tbt, 'sandal'. Hence semi-phon. or phon. det. [t]ṯb[/t], later tb, in [t]ṯb[/t] 'be shod'; [t]ṯbw[/t] 'sandal-maker'.
Ideo. in [t]šwt[/t] 'shadow', 'shade'. Ideo. or det. in sryt '(military) standard'.

Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫw[/t] 'fan'.

[t]ꜥwt[/t] 'flock(s)'; Pyr. [t]ꜥwt[/t] 'awet-sceptre'. sign list.description: peasant's crook (N.B. not curved backward like S 38)
sign list.notes: Cf. [t]ꜥwt[/t], name of the sceptre of the shape . Usually replaced in hieroglyphic writing by S 38, but occasionally phon. [t]ꜥwt[/t], ex. [t]ꜥwt[/t] 'flocks'.

sign list.description: sceptre with straight shaft and head of Seth-(?)animal (cf. too R 19)
sign list.notes:
Ideo. or det. in [t]wꜢs[/t], var. Pyr. wꜢś, 'was-sceptre'; hence phon. or phon. det. [t]wꜢs[/t] (wꜢś), ex. [t]wꜢsi[/t] 'decay'. In hieroglyphic writing usually represents also the djam-sceptre S 41, exx. [t]ḏꜥm[/t] 'djam-sceptre', whence phon. [t]ḏꜥm[/t] in [t]ḏꜥm[/t] 'fine gold'. Phon. [t]wꜢb[/t] (?) in [t]WꜢb[/t](wy) (?) 'the Oxyrhynchite nome', on the evidence of a twice found name of a locality [t]WꜢbwt[/t]. Phon. [t]iꜢtt[/t] in [t]iꜢtt[/t] 'milk', 'cream'.
For see R 19; for see S 14*.

sign list.description: sceptre with spiral shaft and head of Seth(?)-animal
sign list.notes: Cf. [t]ḏꜥm[/t], name of a sceptre of the form . Hence phon. [t]ḏꜥm[/t], occasionally in inscriptions of Dyn. XVIII in [t]ḏꜥmw[/t] 'fine gold'.

sign list.description: sceptre of authority (it is impossible to distinguish separate forms for the various uses)
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]ꜥbꜢ[/t] 'aba-sceptre'; hence phon. or phon. det. [t]ꜥbꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ꜥbꜢ[/t] 'stela'; [t]ꜥb[/t]([t]Ꜣ[/t]) 'shine'. From a sceptre named [t]sḫm[/t] (śḫm), 'sekhem-sceptre', phon. [t]sḫm[/t] (śḫm), exx. [t]sḫm[/t] 'have power'; very late var. [t]sḫm[/t] 'sisrum'. Ideo. or det. in [t]ḫrp[/t] 'be at head', 'control' and related words, cf. D 44. In title is possibly always to be read [t]ḫrp[/t]; at all events this reading is verifiable in some cases, exx. [t]ḫrp[/t] nsty 'controller of the two seats', a priestly title; [t]ḫrp[/t] [t]kꜢt[/t] 'controller of works', cf. [t]ḫrp[/t] [t]kꜢt[/t] 'to undertake works', 'construction'.
Ideo. in md(w) 'walking-stick', 'staff'. Hence phon. md in m(w)dw 'speak' and derivatives.
Ideo. or det. in [t]Ꜣms[/t] (Ꜣmś) ames-sceptre'.

sign list.description: flagellum; perhaps originally used by goat-herds for collecting ladanum
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]nḫḫw[/t], var. [t]nḫꜢḫꜢ[/t], 'flagellum'.

sign list.description: prehistoric mace with cup- or dish-shaped head
sign list.notes: Cf. mnw 'mace', name of this type of mace on M.K. coffins. Hence phon. mnw, exx. m n.k 'take to thyself'; Swmnw, var. Smnw, 'Sumenu', a town where Sobek was worshipped, possibly El-Rizeiqat, 14 km. N. of Gebelen.

sign list.description: mace with pear-shaped head in act of smiting
sign list.notes: Det. in sqr (śqr), var. sq(r)i, 'smite'.
Ideo. in [t]ḥḏ[/t] 'mace'. Hence phon. [t]ḥḏ[/t], exx. [t]ḥḏi[/t] 'damage; [t]ḥḏ[/t] 'be bright', 'white'.

sign list.description: the same with a strap to pass round hand
sign list.notes: Use as last.
Use as last.

sign list.description: combination of T 3 and two I 10
sign list.notes:
Phon. [t]ḥḏḏ[/t], ex. [t]ḥḏḏwt[/t] 'brightness'.
For see O 2; for see S 14.
Det. in O.K. mibt 'axe', which is undoubtedly related to M.K. minb 'axe'. Det. in [t]mdḥm[/t] var, [t]mḏḥ[/t], 'hew', and ideo. in the related words [t]mḏḥ[/t](w) 'carpenter', 'shipwright'.
Det. in [t]Ꜣqḥw[/t] 'axe'.
Det. of mtpnt 'dagger'. Phon. in tpy 'chief', 'first', 'being upon', value probably derived from an obsolete word tp 'dagger' found only once and obviously related to mtpnt mentioned above.

sign list.description: dagger of M.K. and later type
sign list.notes: Det. in b([t]Ꜣ[/t])gsw 'dagger'.

sign list.description: bow consisting of oryx horns joined by a wooden center-piece
sign list.notes: Ideo. or det. in [t]pḏt[/t] 'bow'. Hence phon. (semi-ideo) or phon. det. [t]pḏ[/t], later pd, in [t]pḏ[/t], later pd, 'stretch' and the related words.
Use as last.

sign list.description: composite bow with middle tied to bow-string when out of use
sign list.notes: Det. in Pyr. iwnt 'bow'. From dyn. XII on preferred to T 9 in the hieroglyphic writing of [t]pḏt[/t] 'bow', 'foreign people', 'troop'; [t]pḏty[/t] 'bowman', while is preferred for phon. [t]pḏ[/t], pd.

det. in [t]ꜥḥꜢ[/t] 'arrow'; [t]šsr[/t] (šśr) 'arrow'; from the latter, phon. det. in [t]sẖr[/t] 'overlay'. Doubtless from an obsolete zin, zwn 'arrow', phon. or phon. det. sin, swn (zin, zwn), exx. swn, var. Pyr. zin, 'perish'; swnt 'sale'; 'physician' swnw, var. O.K. zinw (?), the M.E. reading swnw on the evidence of a var. wr swnw 'chief of physicians'.

Ideo. or det. in rwd, varr. Pyr. [t]rwḏ[/t], 'string', 'bow-string'. Hence phon. or phon. det. [t]rwḏ[/t], rwd, exx. rwd, var. Pyr. [t]rwḏ[/t], 'be hard', 'firm'; rwdt, var. [t]rwḏt[/t], 'sandstone'. Ideographic det. in [t]Ꜣr[/t] 'restrain'; hence phon. det. [t]Ꜣr[/t], [t]Ꜣi[/t], exx. [t]mꜢi[/t](r) 'wretched'; [t]dꜢi[/t](r), abbrev. [t]dꜢr[/t] 'subdue'.

sign list.description: pieces of wood joined and lashed at the joint
sign list.notes: Semi-ideo. (?) in rs (rś) 'be wakeful', 'vigilant' and derivatives; phon. rs in rst 'foreign hordes'.

sign list.description: (1) throw-stick, (2) club as a foreign weapon of warfare
sign list.notes: (1) det. in [t]ꜥmꜥꜢt[/t] 'throw-stick' with the related verb [t]ꜥmꜥꜢ[/t] 'throw'; also in [t]qmꜢ[/t] 'throw' and the kindred [t]qmꜢ[/t] 'create', 'form' and derivatives. The combination in [t]qmꜢ[/t] above-quoted and in [t]ṯni[/t] 'distinquish' indicates that is here the throw-stick, not the club, see on G 41. (2) As club, is found in Ṯḥnw 'Libya; [t]ꜥꜢm[/t] 'Asiatic'. Extended gradually as det. to all foreign peoples and countries, exx. [t]Tmḥi[/t] 'TemHi-land'; [t]Nḥsy[/t] 'Nubian'. (3) takes he place of various other signs, partly due to identity or close similarity in hieratic; thus it takes the place of (a) Aa 26 in sbi 'rebel'; (b) of M 3 in [t]ḏꜥr[/t] 'search for'; (c) of P 11 in m(i)ni 'moor'; (d) of T 13, see under that sign; (e) probably also of D 50 in mtr 'witness' and the like, though examples of such confusion in modern publications may sometimes be due to inexact copying.
Use as last.
Det. in [t]ḫpš[/t] 'scimetar'.

sign list.description: reed-float used in fishing and hunting the hippopotamus
sign list.notes: Cf. [t]ḏbꜢw[/t] 'floats'. Phon. [t]ḏbꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ḏbꜢ[/t] 'cloth', 'adorn'; [t]ḏbꜢ[/t], var. [t]dbꜢ[/t], 'replace'.
Ideo. or det. in [t]sḫt[/t] (śḫt) 'trap,' 'snare (birds)' and derivatives.
Use as last.

sign list.description: butcher's block (to be distinguished from W 11 and W 12)
sign list.notes: Semi-ideo. (?) in [t]ẖr[/t] 'under'. Phon. [t]ẖr[/t], exx. [t]mẖr[/t] 'storehouse'; [t]ẖrt[/t] 'portion', 'due'.

Ideo. in nmt 'place of slaughter'.
For see R 10; for see W 5.

sign list.notes:
Det. knife, ex. ds 'knife' (semi-ideo. in ds 'flint'); sharp, in dm 'be sharp', 'pronounce (name)'; cut, exx. [t]šꜥd[/t] 'cut down'; [t]rḫs[/t] 'slaughter'; [t]ḫti[/t] 'carve'. Note the abbrev. dmt 'knife'.
For see D 57.
Phon. [t]sšm[/t] (śšm) in [t]sšm[/t] (śšm) 'guide', 'lead' and derivatives.
Phon. [t]sšm[/t] in [t]sšm[/t] (śšm) 'guide', 'lead'.
Ideo. in śšm (?) 'butcher'.
Ideo. in nm 'knife (?)'. Hence phon. nm, exx. [t]nmḥ[/t] 'orphan'; [t]ḫnms[/t] 'friend'.
Use as last.

Ideo. in [t]mꜢ[/t] 'sickle-shaped end' of the [t]wiꜢ[/t]-boat P 3. Hence phon. [t]mꜢ[/t], exx. [t]mꜢꜢ[/t] 'see'; [t]tmꜢ[/t] 'mat'. In group-writing is used for m. A sign similar, but not quite identical, in shape is used as det. in [t]Ꜣsḫ[/t] 'reap'; also perhaps in [t]ḫꜢbb[/t], var. [t]ẖꜢbb[/t], 'crookedness'.
Use as last.
In [t]mꜢꜢ[/t] 'see'.

In [t]mꜢꜥt[/t] 'truth' and the related words.

Use as last.

Det. cultivate, hack up, exx. [t]ꜥd[/t] 'hack up'; [t]ḫbs[/t] 'cultivate', 'hoe'. For unknown reason, phon. mr, exx. mri 'love'; [t]mrḥt[/t] 'unguent'. Sometimes in place of U 8, phon. [t]ḥn[/t], ex. [t]ḥn[/t] 'go', 'depart'.
Use as last.

sign list.description: hoe, without the rope connecting the two pieces
sign list.notes: Det. in Pyr. 'hoe'. Hence phon. [t]ḥn[/t], ex. [t]ḥnw[/t] '[t]ḥnw[/t]-barque'.
Det. grain, exx. bdt 'emmer'; [t]sšr[/t] (old śšr) 'corn'; measure, exx. [t]ḫꜢi[/t] 'measure'; [t]ḥqꜢt[/t] 'hekat-measure'.

V onwards replaces U 14 as phon. or phon. det. [t]šnꜥ[/t] in [t]šnꜥ[/t] 'repel'; [t]šnꜥw[/t] 'policing'; [t]šnꜥ[/t] 'magazine', 'ergastulum'.

sign list.description: sledge with head of a jackal bearing a load of metal (?)
sign list.notes: Det. in [t]wnš[/t] 'sledge'. Ideo. (?) in Pyr. [t]biꜢi[/t] 'of copper' (adj.). Hence perhaps phon. or phon. det. [t]biꜢ[/t] in by (orig. [t]biꜢ[/t]) 'wonder', and related words; for the reading cf. [t]biꜢt[/t] 'wonder' (n.).
Ideo. in grg 'found', 'established', 'snare'. Hence phon. det. grg in grg 'falsehood, 'lie'.
Use as last.
Ideo. in Pyr. nwty 'the two adzes'. Hence phon. nw in groups, exx. nw 'this'; [t]nwḥ[/t] 'rope'. In group writing used for n.
Use as last.

sign list.description: adze at work on a block of wood
sign list.notes: Det. in O.K. śtp 'cut up' ox. Hence semi-ideo. or phon. stp (śtp), in stp 'choose' and derivatives; inaccurately also [t]sṯp[/t], in [t]sṯp[/t], var. Pyr. śṯp, 'leap up'.
Det. in O.K. [t]mnḫ[/t] 'fashion', 'carve' and [t]mnḫ[/t] 'chisel'. Hence semi-ideo. in [t]mnḫ[/t] 'be efficient' and the related words.

For unknown reason, phon. mr, exx. mr 'be ill'; smr 'friend', 'courtier'. Also for unknown reason, phon. [t]Ꜣb[/t], exx. [t]Ꜣbi[/t] 'desire'; [t]Ꜣbḫ[/t] 'be united in'.
For , see Aa 21, 22.

sign list.description: stone-worker's drill weighted at the top with stones (Dyn. XVIII)
sign list.notes: Ideo. in [t]ḥmt[/t] 'craft', 'art' and the related words.

sign list.description: drill being used to bore a hole in a bead (Dyn. XVIII)

Cf. [t]ḏꜢ[/t] 'fire-drill'. Hence phon. [t]ḏꜢ[/t], exx. [t]ḏꜢi[/t] 'ferry across' [t]ḥꜥḏꜢ[/t] 'pillage'; [t]ḏꜢt[/t] 'remainder'. Abbrev. for [t]wḏꜢ[/t] in the formula [t]ꜥnḫ[/t] [t]wḏꜢ[/t] snb 'may he live, be prosperous, be healthy'. In group-writing or is phon. [t]ḏ[/t].

sign list.description: O.K. form of last (also used later)
